-- PropertyInputsScreen: wires the screen types' sections (Blur, Bloom, CC, Atmosphere,
-- ImageLabel). (ctx, connectors)
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local ImageSheetSize = require(script.Parent.Parent.ImageSheetSize)
local AxisGraphPreview = require(script.Parent.AxisGraphPreview)

return function(ctx, C)
	local Connections = ctx.Connections
	local ChangeHistoryService = ctx.ChangeHistoryService
	local TypeRegistry = ctx.TypeRegistry
	local util = ctx.util
	local UI = ctx.UI

	local readProp = function(item, propName) return util.readProp(TypeRegistry, item, propName) end
	local writeProp = function(item, propName, value) util.writeProp(TypeRegistry, item, propName, value) end
	local safeRange = util.safeRange
	local populateGraphInput = util.populateGraphInput
	local isShiftHeld = C.isShiftHeld

	-- An axis graph row; graphs are stored at baseKey .. axis (SizeScaleX ...).
	local function wireAxisGraphSelect(typeRef, baseKey, getItems, writeFor)
		local ref = typeRef[baseKey]
		if not ref then return end
		local function refreshAxisInput()
			if not ref.input then return end
			local selAxes = ref.getSelected()
			local items = getItems()
			if #selAxes == 0 or #items == 0 then ref.input.Text = ""; return end
			local primary = ref.getPrimary and ref.getPrimary()
			if primary then
				local seq = readProp(items[1], primary)
				if seq and typeof(seq) == "NumberSequence" then
					local firstStr = tostring(seq)
					for _, axisKey in ipairs(selAxes) do
						for _, item in ipairs(items) do
							if tostring(readProp(item, axisKey)) ~= firstStr then
								ref.input.Text = "~"
								return
							end
						end
					end
					populateGraphInput(ref, seq)
				else ref.input.Text = "" end
			else ref.input.Text = "" end
		end
		if ref.setOnSelectionChanged then ref.setOnSelectionChanged(refreshAxisInput) end
		if ref.dotsBtn then
			ref.dotsBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
				if isShiftHeld() and ctx._showDotsMenu then
					local primary = ref.getPrimary and ref.getPrimary()
					if primary then ctx._showDotsMenu(ref.dotsBtn, typeRef, primary, getItems, readProp, writeProp) end
					return
				end
				if not ctx.graphEditor then return end
				local selAxes = ref.getSelected(); local items = getItems()
				if #selAxes == 0 or #items == 0 then return end
				local primary = ref.getPrimary and ref.getPrimary() or selAxes[1]
				local firstGraph = readProp(items[1], primary)
				if not firstGraph or typeof(firstGraph) ~= "NumberSequence" then return end
				local snapshot, selSnap = {table.unpack(items)}, {table.unpack(selAxes)}
				local axisNames = {}; for _, k in ipairs(selSnap) do table.insert(axisNames, k:sub(#baseKey + 1)) end
				-- The editor opens on the first axis's handles; Apply writes new handles to every selected axis.
				local primaryCfg = TypeRegistry.getConfig(snapshot[1])
				local bezJSON = primaryCfg and primaryCfg:GetAttribute(primary .. "_BezierHandles") or nil
				ctx.graphEditor:Open(firstGraph, baseKey .. " (" .. table.concat(axisNames, "+") .. ")", function(newSeq, bezData)
					ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Edit " .. baseKey)
					local encoded = bezData and HttpService:JSONEncode(bezData) or nil
					for _, axisKey in ipairs(selSnap) do
						for _, item in ipairs(snapshot) do
							writeProp(item, axisKey, newSeq)
							local cfg = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
							if cfg then cfg:SetAttribute(axisKey .. "_BezierHandles", encoded) end
						end
					end
					ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Edit " .. baseKey)
					refreshAxisInput()
					if ctx._refreshSnapshots then task.defer(ctx._refreshSnapshots) end
				end, AxisGraphPreview(snapshot, selSnap, firstGraph, readProp, writeProp), bezJSON)
			end)
		end
		if ref.input then
			-- As a mesh's graph input: "n" (a flat graph) or "lo, hi" (an envelope), the cGraphInline parser;
			-- invalid text flashes and restores.
			local savedText = ref.input.Text
			local pfxF = "AGS_Focus_"..writeFor.."_"; local pfx = "AGS_"..writeFor.."_"
			Connections[pfxF..baseKey] = ref.input.Focused:Connect(function()
				savedText = ref.input.Text
				if ref.input.Text == "<NumberSequence>" or ref.input.Text == "~" then ref.input.Text = "" end
			end)
			Connections[pfx..baseKey] = ref.input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				local selAxes = ref.getSelected(); local items = getItems()
				if #selAxes == 0 or #items == 0 then ref.input.Text = savedText; return end
				local txt = ref.input.Text
				if txt == "" or txt == "<NumberSequence>" or txt == "~" then ref.input.Text = savedText; C.flashInvalid(ref.input); return end
				local parts = {}; for v in txt:gmatch("[^,]+") do local nn = tonumber(v:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")); if nn then parts[#parts+1] = nn end end
				local newSeq
				if #parts == 2 then
					local lo, hi = math.min(parts[1], parts[2]), math.max(parts[1], parts[2])
					if lo == hi then newSeq = NumberSequence.new(lo)
					else local mid = (lo + hi) / 2; local env = (hi - lo) / 2
						newSeq = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, mid, env), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, mid, env)}) end
				elseif #parts == 1 then newSeq = NumberSequence.new(parts[1])
				else ref.input.Text = savedText; C.flashInvalid(ref.input); return end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Edit " .. baseKey)
				for _, axisKey in ipairs(selAxes) do
					for _, item in ipairs(items) do
						writeProp(item, axisKey, newSeq)
						-- The old handles no longer match the new keypoints.
						local cfg = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
						if cfg then pcall(function() cfg:SetAttribute(axisKey .. "_BezierHandles", nil) end) end
					end
				end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Edit " .. baseKey)
				refreshAxisInput()
			end)
		end
	end

	-- Kept alike by hand with wireEmissionMode in PropertyInputs/init.
	local function wireEmissionMode(typeRef, getItems, connKey)
		local modeRef = typeRef and typeRef.EmissionMode
		local loopRef = typeRef and typeRef.AnimateLoop
		local enabledRef = typeRef and typeRef.Enabled
		if modeRef and modeRef.setOnChanged then
			modeRef.setOnChanged(function()
				task.defer(function()
					local text = modeRef.dropdown and modeRef.dropdown.Text
					if not text then return end
					ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set EmissionMode")
					for _, v in ipairs(getItems()) do v:SetAttribute("EmissionMode", text) end
					ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set EmissionMode")
					local isAnim = (text == "Animate")
					if loopRef and loopRef.toggle then loopRef.row.Visible = isAnim end
					if enabledRef and enabledRef.toggle then enabledRef.row.Visible = not isAnim end
				end)
			end)
		end
		if loopRef and loopRef.toggle then
			Connections["T_AnimLoop_"..connKey] = loopRef.toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
				task.defer(function()
					local isOn = loopRef.toggle:GetAttribute("IsOn")
					ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Toggle AnimateLoop")
					for _, v in ipairs(getItems()) do
						v:SetAttribute("AnimateLoop", isOn or false)
						-- Turning it on starts an idle item's Animate cycle, as the toolbar does.
						if isOn and ctx and ctx.Part and ctx.Part.ActiveAnimates and not ctx.Part.ActiveAnimates[v] then
							pcall(function() ctx.Part:EmitAnimate(v) end)
						end
					end
					ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Toggle AnimateLoop")
				end)
			end)
		end
	end

	local BL = UI.Blur; if BL then
		C.cInput(BL, "Rate", tonumber, "Blur"); C.cInput(BL, "Keyframes", tonumber, "Blur", "TotalKeyFrames"); C.cInput(BL, "Lifetime", safeRange, "Blur"); C.cInput(BL, "Linger", tonumber, "Blur", "PartLife")
		C.cToggle(BL, "Enabled", "Blur"); wireEmissionMode(BL, function() return ctx.selectedBlurs end, "Blur")
		local function sbl() return ctx.selectedBlurs end
		for _, k in ipairs({"Size","Timescale"}) do C.cGraphDots(BL, k, sbl, readProp, writeProp); C.cGraphInline(BL, k, sbl, writeProp, "Blur_") end
		C.wireConfigButtons(BL, sbl)
	end

	local BM = UI.Bloom; if BM then
		C.cInput(BM, "Rate", tonumber, "Bloom"); C.cInput(BM, "Keyframes", tonumber, "Bloom", "TotalKeyFrames"); C.cInput(BM, "Lifetime", safeRange, "Bloom"); C.cInput(BM, "Linger", tonumber, "Bloom", "PartLife")
		C.cToggle(BM, "Enabled", "Bloom"); wireEmissionMode(BM, function() return ctx.selectedBlooms end, "Bloom")
		local function sbm() return ctx.selectedBlooms end
		for _, k in ipairs({"Intensity","Size","Threshold","Timescale"}) do C.cGraphDots(BM, k, sbm, readProp, writeProp); C.cGraphInline(BM, k, sbm, writeProp, "Bloom_") end
		C.wireConfigButtons(BM, sbm)
	end

	local CC = UI.ColorCorrection; if CC then
		C.cInput(CC, "Rate", tonumber, "CC"); C.cInput(CC, "Keyframes", tonumber, "CC", "TotalKeyFrames"); C.cInput(CC, "Lifetime", safeRange, "CC"); C.cInput(CC, "Linger", tonumber, "CC", "PartLife")
		C.cToggle(CC, "Enabled", "CC"); wireEmissionMode(CC, function() return ctx.selectedColorCorrections end, "CC")
		local function scc() return ctx.selectedColorCorrections end
		for _, k in ipairs({"Brightness","Contrast","Saturation","Timescale"}) do C.cGraphDots(CC, k, scc, readProp, writeProp); C.cGraphInline(CC, k, scc, writeProp, "CC_") end
		C.cColorDots(CC, "TintColor", scc, readProp, writeProp); C.cColorInline(CC, "TintColor", scc, writeProp, "CC_"); C.cColorSwatch(CC, "TintColor", scc, readProp, writeProp)
		C.wireConfigButtons(CC, scc)
	end

	local AM = UI.Atmosphere; if AM then
		C.cInput(AM, "Rate", tonumber, "Atm"); C.cInput(AM, "Keyframes", tonumber, "Atm", "TotalKeyFrames"); C.cInput(AM, "Lifetime", safeRange, "Atm"); C.cInput(AM, "Linger", tonumber, "Atm", "PartLife")
		C.cToggle(AM, "Enabled", "Atm"); wireEmissionMode(AM, function() return ctx.selectedAtmospheres end, "Atm")
		local function sam() return ctx.selectedAtmospheres end
		for _, k in ipairs({"Density","Offset","Glare","Haze","Timescale"}) do C.cGraphDots(AM, k, sam, readProp, writeProp); C.cGraphInline(AM, k, sam, writeProp, "Atm_") end
		for _, k in ipairs({"Color","Decay"}) do C.cColorDots(AM, k, sam, readProp, writeProp); C.cColorInline(AM, k, sam, writeProp, "Atm_"); C.cColorSwatch(AM, k, sam, readProp, writeProp) end
		C.wireConfigButtons(AM, sam)
	end

	local parseCSV = util.parseCSV
	-- nil on text with no numbers, so cInput flashes and restores instead of writing zeros.
	local function parseUDim2(t)
		local v = parseCSV(t, 4); if not v then return nil end
		return UDim2.new(v[1] or 0, v[2] or 0, v[3] or 0, v[4] or 0)
	end
	local function parseVec2(t)
		local v = parseCSV(t, 2); if not v then return nil end
		return Vector2.new(v[1] or 0, v[2] or 0)
	end
	local IL = UI.ImageLabel; if IL then
		C.cInput(IL, "Rate", tonumber, "Img"); C.cInput(IL, "Keyframes", tonumber, "Img", "TotalKeyFrames"); C.cInput(IL, "Lifetime", safeRange, "Img"); C.cInput(IL, "Linger", tonumber, "Img", "PartLife")
		C.cToggle(IL, "Enabled", "Img"); wireEmissionMode(IL, function() return ctx.selectedImageLabels end, "Img")
		C.cInput(IL, "Image", tostring, "Img")
		-- A new Image stamps each selected item's `_SheetSize`: emits read the attribute, so a game
		-- script never needs the plugin's HTTP request.
		if IL.Image and IL.Image.input then
			-- The items at focus; ImageSheetSize caches by asset id.
			local imageSnap = nil
			Connections["F_Image_Focus"] = IL.Image.input.Focused:Connect(function()
				imageSnap = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedImageLabels)}
			end)
			Connections["F_Image_Sheet"] = IL.Image.input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				local text = IL.Image.input.Text
				for _, it in ipairs(imageSnap or ctx.selectedImageLabels) do ImageSheetSize.fetchAndStamp(it, text) end
				imageSnap = nil
			end)
		end
		-- An item attribute; EnabledLoop pins the texture.
		if IL.PreloadTexture and IL.PreloadTexture.toggle then
			Connections["T_PreloadTexture_Img"] = IL.PreloadTexture.toggle.Activated:Connect(function() task.defer(function()
				local isOn = IL.PreloadTexture.toggle:GetAttribute("IsOn") or false
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Toggle PreloadTexture")
				for _, v in ipairs(ctx.selectedImageLabels) do v:SetAttribute("PreloadTexture", isOn) end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Toggle PreloadTexture") end) end)
		end
		C.cDropdown(IL, "ScaleType", Enum.ScaleType, "Img")
		C.cDropdown(IL, "ResampleMode", Enum.ResamplerMode, "Img")
		C.cInput(IL, "Position", parseUDim2, "Img")
		C.cInput(IL, "ImgSize", parseUDim2, "Img", "Size")
		C.cInput(IL, "AnchorPoint", parseVec2, "Img")
		C.cInput(IL, "ZIndex", tonumber, "Img")
		C.cInput(IL, "EmissionAngle", tonumber, "Img")
		C.cInput(IL, "SpreadAngle", tonumber, "Img")
		C.cInput(IL, "Acceleration", parseVec2, "Img")
		C.cInput(IL, "Drag", tonumber, "Img")
		C.cToggle(IL, "InvertMotion", "Img")
		C.cInput(IL, "RotRange", safeRange, "Img")
		-- Grid is for a Spritesheet source only.
		local function setFlipbookRowsVisible(isSpritesheet)
			if IL.Grid and IL.Grid.input then IL.Grid.row.Visible = isSpritesheet end
		end
		-- RotMode and FlipbookSource are string dropdowns, not Enums.
		local function wireStringDropdown(refKey, propName, setVisibleHook)
			local mr = IL[refKey]
			if not mr or not mr.setOnChanged then return end
			mr.setOnChanged(function()
				task.defer(function()
					local text = mr.dropdown and mr.dropdown.Text
					if not text then return end
					ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set " .. propName)
					for _, v in ipairs(ctx.selectedImageLabels) do writeProp(v, propName, text) end
					ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set " .. propName)
					if setVisibleHook then setVisibleHook(text == "Spritesheet") end
				end)
			end)
		end
		wireStringDropdown("FlipbookSource", "FlipbookSource", setFlipbookRowsVisible)
		wireStringDropdown("RotMode", "RotMode", nil)
		C.cDropdown(IL, "FlipbookMode", Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode, "Img")
		C.cToggle(IL, "FlipbookStartRandom", "Img")
		-- One "cols, rows" input writes GridCols and GridRows.
		if IL.Grid and IL.Grid.input then
			local gridSnap = nil
			Connections["P_Grid_Focus"] = IL.Grid.input.Focused:Connect(function()
				gridSnap = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedImageLabels)}
			end)
			Connections["P_Grid_Img"] = IL.Grid.input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				local txt = IL.Grid.input.Text
				if txt == "" or txt == "-" or txt == "~" then gridSnap = nil; return end
				local v = util.parseCSV(txt, 2); if not v then gridSnap = nil; return end
				local cols, rows = math.max(1, math.floor(v[1] or 1)), math.max(1, math.floor(v[2] or 1))
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set Grid")
				for _, it in ipairs(gridSnap or ctx.selectedImageLabels) do
					writeProp(it, "GridCols", cols); writeProp(it, "GridRows", rows)
				end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set Grid")
				IL.Grid.input.Text = cols .. ", " .. rows
				gridSnap = nil
			end)
		end
		C.cInput(IL, "FlipbookFramerate", safeRange, "Img")
		C.cToggle(IL, "FlipbookReverse", "Img")
		-- SizeScale is an axis graph row (SizeScaleX / Y).
		local function sil() return ctx.selectedImageLabels end
		for _, k in ipairs({"ImageTransparency","BackgroundTransparency","Speed","RotSpeed","Timescale"}) do
			C.cGraphDots(IL, k, sil, readProp, writeProp); C.cGraphInline(IL, k, sil, writeProp, "Img_")
		end
		wireAxisGraphSelect(IL, "SizeScale", sil, "Img")
		for _, k in ipairs({"ImageColor3", "BackgroundColor3"}) do
			C.cColorDots(IL, k, sil, readProp, writeProp); C.cColorInline(IL, k, sil, writeProp, "Img_"); C.cColorSwatch(IL, k, sil, readProp, writeProp)
		end
		C.wireConfigButtons(IL, sil)
	end
end

-- PropertyInputsSound: wires the Sound section. (deps) from PropertyInputs/init.

return function(deps)
	local ctx = deps.ctx
	local C = deps.C
	local UI = deps.UI
	local readProp = deps.readProp
	local writeProp = deps.writeProp
	local safeRange = deps.safeRange
	local wireConfigButtons = C.wireConfigButtons

	local SND = UI.Sound
	if not SND then return end
	local function ssnd() return ctx.selectedSounds end

	C.cToggle(SND, "Enabled", "Snd")
	C.cToggle(SND, "Looped", "Snd")
	C.cToggle(SND, "Local2D", "Snd")
	C.cInput(SND, "Rate", tonumber, "Snd")
	C.cInput(SND, "Lifetime", safeRange, "Snd")
	C.cInput(SND, "StartOffset", tonumber, "Snd")
	C.cInput(SND, "RollOffMin", tonumber, "Snd")
	C.cInput(SND, "RollOffMax", tonumber, "Snd")
	C.cInput(SND, "Keyframes", tonumber, "Snd", "TotalKeyFrames")

	for _, k in ipairs({"Volume", "PlaybackSpeed", "Timescale"}) do
		C.cGraphDots(SND, k, ssnd, readProp, writeProp)
		C.cGraphInline(SND, k, ssnd, writeProp, "Snd_")
	end
	wireConfigButtons(SND, function() return ctx.selectedSounds end)
end

-- PropertyInputsTypeSections: wires the Part, Beam, PointLight, Highlight, TrailEmitter, Trail,
-- BeamNative, Attachment and Model sections. (deps) from PropertyInputs/init.

-- Writes to the LIVE RenderTemplate skip TypeRegistry.write, so they bump its _PoolGen here, or
-- pooled visuals would keep the old Material, Texture or Attachment.
local function bumpRTPoolGen(item)
	if not item then return end
	local rt = item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
	if not rt then return end
	local cur = rt:GetAttribute("_PoolGen") or 0
	pcall(function() rt:SetAttribute("_PoolGen", cur + 1) end)
end

return function(deps)
	local ctx = deps.ctx
	local C = deps.C
	local UI = deps.UI
	local sel = deps.sel
	local Connections = deps.Connections
	local ChangeHistoryService = deps.ChangeHistoryService
	local readProp = deps.readProp
	local writeProp = deps.writeProp
	local parseCSV = deps.parseCSV
	local safeRange = deps.safeRange
	local wireAxisGraphSelect = deps.wireAxisGraphSelect
	local wireAxisInput = deps.wireAxisInput
	local wireAxisEvenToggles = deps.wireAxisEvenToggles
	local wireLinkMode = deps.wireLinkMode
	local wireLinkAxes = deps.wireLinkAxes
	local wireRotMode = deps.wireRotMode
	local wireRotOrder = deps.wireRotOrder
	local wirePosMode = deps.wirePosMode
	local wireDisplacementMode = deps.wireDisplacementMode
	local wireOrientation = deps.wireOrientation
	local wireDirMode = deps.wireDirMode
	local wireEmissionMode = deps.wireEmissionMode
	local wireItemAttrToggle = deps.wireItemAttrToggle
	local wireConfigButtons = C.wireConfigButtons

	local P = UI.Part
	if P then
		C.cInput(P, "Rate", tonumber, "Part"); C.cInput(P, "Drag", tonumber, "Part")
		C.cInput(P, "ShapePartial", tonumber, "Part"); C.cInput(P, "Keyframes", tonumber, "Part", "TotalKeyFrames"); C.cInput(P, "Linger", tonumber, "Part", "PartLife")
		C.cInput(P, "Lifetime", safeRange, "Part")
		C.cInput(P, "RotX", safeRange, "Part"); C.cInput(P, "RotY", safeRange, "Part"); C.cInput(P, "RotZ", safeRange, "Part")
		C.cInput(P, "RotationEvenCycle", safeRange, "Part"); C.cInput(P, "PositionEvenCycle", safeRange, "Part")
		C.cInput(P, "SpreadAngle", function(t) local v = parseCSV(t,2); if not v then return nil end; return Vector2.new(v[1],v[2]) end, "Part")
		C.cInput(P, "Acceleration", function(t) local v = parseCSV(t,3); if not v then return nil end; return Vector3.new(v[1],v[2],v[3]) end, "Part")
		C.cToggle(P, "InvertMotion", "Part"); C.cToggle(P, "Enabled", "Part"); C.cToggle(P, "Pool", "Part")
		wireDirMode(P, function() return ctx.selectedParts end, "Part")
		wireOrientation(P, function() return ctx.selectedParts end, "Part")
		C.cInput(P, "ZOffset", tonumber, "Part")
		C.cToggle(P, "FlipStartRandom", "Part", "FlipbookStartRandom"); C.cToggle(P, "FlipReverse", "Part", "FlipbookReverse")
		wireEmissionMode(P, function() return ctx.selectedParts end, "Part"); wireItemAttrToggle(P, "PreloadTexture", function() return ctx.selectedParts end, "Part")
		wireLinkMode(P, function() return ctx.selectedParts end)
		wireLinkAxes(P, function() return ctx.selectedParts end, "Part_")
		wireConfigButtons(P, function() return ctx.selectedParts end)

		-- UseShape is its own boolean attribute; ShapeInOut is a separate dropdown.
		if P.UseShape and P.UseShape.toggle then Connections["T_UseShape_Part"] = P.UseShape.toggle.Activated:Connect(function() task.defer(function()
			local val = P.UseShape.toggle:GetAttribute("IsOn")
			if P.UseShape.fields then P.UseShape.fields.Visible = val end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Toggle UseShape")
			sel.writeForParts("UseShape", val)
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Toggle UseShape")
		end) end) end

		C.cToggleGroup(P, "AccelerationTowardsInstance", "Part", "Accel toward")

		C.cDropdown(P, "Direction", Enum.NormalId, "Part", "EmissionDirection")
		C.cDropdown(P, "Shape", Enum.ParticleEmitterShape, "Part")
		C.cDropdown(P, "ShapeInOut", Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut, "Part")
		C.cToggle(P, "LookAtInitially", "Part")
		C.cDropdown(P, "FlipMode", Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode, "Part", "FlipbookMode")
		C.cDropdown(P, "MeshFrameMode", Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode, "Part")
		C.cInput(P, "MeshFrameFramerate", safeRange, "Part")
		C.cToggle(P, "MeshFrameStartRandom", "Part")
		C.cToggle(P, "MeshFrameReverse", "Part")

		if P.Material and P.Material.setOnChanged then P.Material.setOnChanged(function()
			local items = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedParts)}
			task.defer(function()
				local matName = P.Material.dropdown.Text
				local ok, mat = pcall(function() return Enum.Material[matName] end)
				if ok and mat then
					ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set Material")
					for _, item in ipairs(items) do

--[[
	QOLPreviews: the Size (Resize), Time (Retime) and Hue tools: live previews, Apply, Reset.
	Previews stack, each pass built from the snapshot (QOLWiring.takeSnapshots): Size, then Time on

	the others previewing on the new snapshot; Reset drops one tool's preview.
	A preview is dropped when its tool leaves the screen (its panel closes, or the Re: deck closes,
	minimizes or tidies away); switching the deck's Size and Time tabs keeps both.
	Writes the LIVE selected items (and their Blender states) through QOL.apply* and HueShift.
	store = { snapshots(), blenderSnapshots(), tintSnapshots(), takeSnapshots(), restoreSnapshots() }
	from QOLWiring.
]]

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local HueShift = require(script.Parent.Modules.HueShift)

local PREVIEW_INTERVAL = 0.1

return function(ctx, store)
	local UI = ctx.UI
	local Connections = ctx.Connections
	local ChangeHistoryService = ctx.ChangeHistoryService
	local QOL = ctx.QOL
	local populate = ctx.populate
	local populateColorInput = ctx.util.populateColorInput

	local function sizeValue()
		return UI.ResizeGetVal and UI.ResizeGetVal() or 1
	end
	local function timeValue()
		return UI.RetimeGetVal and UI.RetimeGetVal() or 1
	end
	local function hueValues()
		local hue = UI.HueGetVal and UI.HueGetVal() or 0
		local saturation = UI.SatGetVal and UI.SatGetVal() or 0
		local value = UI.ValGetVal and UI.ValGetVal() or 0
		return hue, saturation, value
	end
	local function hueActive()
		local hue, saturation, value = hueValues()
		return hue ~= 0 or saturation ~= 0 or value ~= 0
	end
	local function scaleShape()
		return UI.ResizeScaleShapeToggle and UI.ResizeScaleShapeToggle:GetAttribute("IsOn")
	end

	-- Trail and BeamNative colours are native properties (no AttributeChanged) and Blender states
	-- show their colour inline, so both refresh by hand. The Decals section is rebuilt whole, only
	-- once the colours settle: on Apply and when the preview drops, not on every slider step.
	local function refreshColorFields(settled)
		if UI._blenderColorRefs then
			for _, entry in ipairs(UI._blenderColorRefs) do
				if entry.config and entry.config.Parent then populateColorInput(entry.refs, entry.config:GetAttribute("Color")) end
			end
		end
		if not populate then return end
		if #ctx.selectedTrails > 0 and populate.populateTrails then pcall(populate.populateTrails, ctx.selectedTrails) end
		if #ctx.selectedBeamNatives > 0 and populate.populateBeamNatives then pcall(populate.populateBeamNatives, ctx.selectedBeamNatives) end
		if settled and #ctx.selectedParts > 0 and populate.populateDecals then
			pcall(populate.populateDecals, ctx.selectedParts)
		end
	end

	-- What the last pass left on the items.
	local shown = { size = 1, time = 1, hue = false }

	-- A tool just back at neutral, or Size and Time together, needs the snapshot restored first.
	local function rebuildPreviews()
		local snapshots = store.snapshots()
		local size = sizeValue()
		local time = timeValue()
		local hueOn = hueActive()
		local restore = (size ~= 1 and time ~= 1)
			or (shown.size ~= 1 and size == 1)
			or (shown.time ~= 1 and time == 1)
			or (shown.hue and not hueOn)
		if restore then store.restoreSnapshots() end

		if size ~= 1 then QOL.applyResize(snapshots, size, scaleShape()) end
		if time ~= 1 then
			local base = snapshots
			if size ~= 1 then
				base = {}
				for item in pairs(snapshots) do
					if item.Parent then base[item] = QOL.snapshotItem(item) end
				end
			end
			QOL.applyRetime(base, time)
		end
		if hueOn then
			local hue, saturation, value = hueValues()
			HueShift.applyToSnapshots(snapshots, hue, saturation, value)
			HueShift.applyToBlender(store.blenderSnapshots(), hue, saturation, value)
			HueShift.applyToTints(store.tintSnapshots(), hue, saturation, value)
		end
		if hueOn or shown.hue then refreshColorFields(not hueOn) end
		shown = { size = size, time = time, hue = hueOn }
	end

	-- One pass per slider change, at most every PREVIEW_INTERVAL.
	local last = { size = 1, time = 1, hue = 0, saturation = 0, value = 0, scaleShape = nil, at = 0 }
	Connections["ToolPreview"] = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		local size = sizeValue()
		local time = timeValue()
		local hue, saturation, value = hueValues()
		local shape = scaleShape()
		if size == last.size and time == last.time and hue == last.hue and saturation == last.saturation
			and value == last.value and shape == last.scaleShape then return end
		if os.clock() - last.at < PREVIEW_INTERVAL then return end
		last = { size = size, time = time, hue = hue, saturation = saturation, value = value, scaleShape = shape, at = os.clock() }
		rebuildPreviews()
	end)

	local function neutralSize()
		if UI.ResizeSetVal then UI.ResizeSetVal(1, true) end
	end
	local function neutralTime()
		if UI.RetimeSetVal then UI.RetimeSetVal(1, true) end
	end
	local function neutralHue()
		if UI.HueSetVal then UI.HueSetVal(0, true) end
		if UI.SatSetVal then UI.SatSetVal(0, true) end
		if UI.ValSetVal then UI.ValSetVal(0, true) end
	end

	-- The snapshot becomes the original plus that tool alone; the other previews go back on top.
	local function commit(beforeWaypoint, afterWaypoint, applyTool, neutral)
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint(beforeWaypoint)
		store.restoreSnapshots()
		applyTool(store.snapshots(), store.blenderSnapshots())
		store.takeSnapshots()
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint(afterWaypoint)
		neutral()
		shown = { size = 1, time = 1, hue = false }
		rebuildPreviews()
	end

	local function onClick(button, connKey, handler)
		if button then Connections[connKey] = button.Activated:Connect(handler) end
	end

	onClick(UI.ResizeApply, "ResizeApply", function()
		commit("Part-Icles: Before Resize", "Part-Icles: Resize", function(snapshots)
			QOL.applyResize(snapshots, sizeValue(), scaleShape())
		end, neutralSize)
	end)
	onClick(UI.RetimeApply, "RetimeApply", function()
		commit("Part-Icles: Before Retime", "Part-Icles: Retime", function(snapshots)
			QOL.applyRetime(snapshots, timeValue())
		end, neutralTime)
	end)
	onClick(UI.HueApply, "HueApply", function()
		commit("Part-Icles: Before Hue Shift", "Part-Icles: Hue Shift", function(snapshots, blenderSnapshots)
			local hue, saturation, value = hueValues()
			HueShift.applyToSnapshots(snapshots, hue, saturation, value)
			HueShift.applyToBlender(blenderSnapshots, hue, saturation, value)
			HueShift.applyToTints(store.tintSnapshots(), hue, saturation, value)
			refreshColorFields(true)
		end, neutralHue)
	end)

	onClick(UI.ResizeReset, "ResizeReset", function()
		neutralSize()
		rebuildPreviews()
	end)
	onClick(UI.RetimeReset, "RetimeReset", function()
		neutralTime()
		rebuildPreviews()
	end)
	onClick(UI.HueReset, "HueReset", function()
		neutralHue()
		rebuildPreviews()
	end)

	-- `deck` (optional): while it is open, the page is only behind another tab.
	local function dropWhenClosed(connKey, page, deck, isDirty, neutral)
		if not page then return end
		Connections[connKey] = page:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
			if page.Visible or not isDirty() then return end
			if deck and deck.Visible then return end
			neutral()
			rebuildPreviews()
		end)
	end
	dropWhenClosed("ResizeHideRevert", UI.ResizePanel, UI.ReDeck, function() return sizeValue() ~= 1 end, neutralSize)
	dropWhenClosed("RetimeHideRevert", UI.RetimePanel, UI.ReDeck, function() return timeValue() ~= 1 end, neutralTime)
	dropWhenClosed("HueHideRevert", UI.HuePanel, nil, hueActive, neutralHue)
end

--[[
	The Properties panel's search: walks PropsScroll (type sections, sub-sections, rows, and the
	rows deeper in toggle groups, decal layers and Blender states), hides rows that do not match,
	and restores the collapse state when cleared.
	(ctx, UI, Connections, populate), required from QOLWiring.
]]

local PropertyCatalog = require(script.Parent.Modules.PropertyCatalog)

return function(ctx, UI, Connections, populate)
	if UI.SearchBox then
		local _searchDebounce = nil
		-- Weak keys: the frames go when the UI is rebuilt.
		local _savedBodyState = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}) -- { [body] = wasVisible } before the first search
		-- Section -> its ctx selection key, read at call time.
		local _sectionCtxKey = {}
		if UI.MeshSection then _sectionCtxKey[UI.MeshSection] = "selectedParts" end
		if UI.BeamSection then _sectionCtxKey[UI.BeamSection] = "selectedBeams" end
		if UI.PointLightSection then _sectionCtxKey[UI.PointLightSection] = "selectedPointLights" end
		if UI.HighlightSection then _sectionCtxKey[UI.HighlightSection] = "selectedHighlights" end
		if UI.TrailEmitterSection then _sectionCtxKey[UI.TrailEmitterSection] = "selectedTrailEmitters" end
		if UI.TrailSection then _sectionCtxKey[UI.TrailSection] = "selectedTrails" end
		if UI.BeamNativeSection then _sectionCtxKey[UI.BeamNativeSection] = "selectedBeamNatives" end
		if UI.AttachmentSection then _sectionCtxKey[UI.AttachmentSection] = "selectedAttachments" end
		if UI.ModelSection then _sectionCtxKey[UI.ModelSection] = "selectedModels" end
		if UI.PESection then _sectionCtxKey[UI.PESection] = "selectedPEs" end
		-- Without these, search hides a screen section that is being edited.
		if UI.BlurSection then _sectionCtxKey[UI.BlurSection] = "selectedBlurs" end
		if UI.BloomSection then _sectionCtxKey[UI.BloomSection] = "selectedBlooms" end
		if UI.ColorCorrectionSection then _sectionCtxKey[UI.ColorCorrectionSection] = "selectedColorCorrections" end
		if UI.AtmosphereSection then _sectionCtxKey[UI.AtmosphereSection] = "selectedAtmospheres" end
		if UI.ImageLabelSection then _sectionCtxKey[UI.ImageLabelSection] = "selectedImageLabels" end
		if UI.LightningSection then _sectionCtxKey[UI.LightningSection] = "selectedLightnings" end
		if UI.CameraShakeSection then _sectionCtxKey[UI.CameraShakeSection] = "selectedCameraShakes" end
		if UI.SoundSection then _sectionCtxKey[UI.SoundSection] = "selectedSounds" end
		if UI.RocksSection then _sectionCtxKey[UI.RocksSection] = "selectedRocks" end
		if UI.RopeSection then _sectionCtxKey[UI.RopeSection] = "selectedRopes" end
		if UI.DistortionSection then _sectionCtxKey[UI.DistortionSection] = "selectedDistortions" end
		if UI.ContainerSection then _sectionCtxKey[UI.ContainerSection] = "selectedContainers" end
		if UI.MatteSection then _sectionCtxKey[UI.MatteSection] = "selectedMattes" end
		if UI.ForceSection then _sectionCtxKey[UI.ForceSection] = "selectedForces" end
		if UI.ReactorSection then _sectionCtxKey[UI.ReactorSection] = "selectedReactors" end
		local function isSectionSelected(s)
			local key = _sectionCtxKey[s]
			return key ~= nil and #ctx[key] > 0
		end

		local function getRowLabel(row)
			local lb = row:FindFirstChild("LabelBlob")
			if lb then
				local l = lb:FindFirstChild("Label")
				if l and l:IsA("TextLabel") then return l.Text:lower() end
			end
			return row.Name:lower()
		end

		-- Matches at the start of the label or after a space or underscore; the query is escaped, as
		-- `(`, `.`, `%`, `[` and `*` would break the pattern.
		local function _escapePattern(s) return (s:gsub("[%(%)%.%%%+%-%*%?%[%]%^%$]", "%%%1")) end
		local function labelMatches(label, query)
			local esc = _escapePattern(query)
			return label:sub(1, #query) == query or label:find("[%s_]" .. esc) ~= nil
		end

		-- A row is a frame with a LabelBlob; any other frame is searched inside (a toggle group's
		-- "<Key>Fields", a Decals or Blender card and its Body). Shows matching rows and their holders,
		-- hides the rest, returns whether a row matched; nil for a frame without rows (a header, a
		-- banner), which is left alone.
		local function filterFrame(frame, query)
			if frame:FindFirstChild("LabelBlob") then
				local match = labelMatches(getRowLabel(frame), query)
				frame.Visible = match
				return match
			end
			local holdsRows, match = false, false
			for _, child in ipairs(frame:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("Frame") and child.Name ~= "" then
					local childMatch = filterFrame(child, query)
					if childMatch ~= nil then
						holdsRows = true
						match = match or childMatch
					end
				end
			end
			if not holdsRows then return nil end
			frame.Visible = match
			return match
		end

		-- Shows the rows and their holders again, a Body as before the search. Returns whether `frame`
		-- holds a row.
		local function restoreFrame(frame)
			if frame:FindFirstChild("LabelBlob") then
				frame.Visible = true
				return true
			end
			local holdsRows = false
			for _, child in ipairs(frame:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("Frame") and child.Name ~= "" and restoreFrame(child) then
					holdsRows = true
				end
			end
			if holdsRows then
				local saved = _savedBodyState[frame]
				if saved ~= nil then frame.Visible = saved else frame.Visible = true end
			end
			return holdsRows
		end

		Connections["PropSearch"] = UI.SearchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
			if _searchDebounce then task.cancel(_searchDebounce) end
			_searchDebounce = task.delay(0.05, function()
				_searchDebounce = nil
				local scroll = UI.PropsScroll; if not scroll then return end
				local query = UI.SearchBox.Text:lower()
				local isSearch = query ~= ""

				if isSearch and next(_savedBodyState) == nil then
					for _, desc in ipairs(scroll:GetDescendants()) do
						if desc.Name == "Body" and desc:IsA("Frame") then _savedBodyState[desc] = desc.Visible end
					end
				end

				for _, ts in ipairs(scroll:GetChildren()) do if not ts:IsA("Frame") then continue end
					local selVisible = isSectionSelected(ts)
					if isSearch then
						local tsBody = ts:FindFirstChild("Body"); if not tsBody then ts.Visible = false; continue end
						local anyMatch = false
						for _, ss in ipairs(tsBody:GetChildren()) do if not ss:IsA("Frame") then continue end
							local sb = ss:FindFirstChild("Body"); if not sb then continue end
							local secHasMatch = false
							for _, row in ipairs(sb:GetChildren()) do if not row:IsA("Frame") or row.Name == "" then continue end
								local match = filterFrame(row, query) == true
								row.Visible = match
								if match then secHasMatch = true end
							end
							sb.Visible = secHasMatch
							ss.Visible = secHasMatch
							if secHasMatch then anyMatch = true end
						end
						ts.Visible = anyMatch and selVisible
					else
						-- Cleared: every row shows, bodies as they were, the section by the selection.
						ts.Visible = selVisible
						local tsBody = ts:FindFirstChild("Body"); if not tsBody then continue end
						for _, ss in ipairs(tsBody:GetChildren()) do if not ss:IsA("Frame") then continue end
							ss.Visible = true
							local sb = ss:FindFirstChild("Body"); if not sb then continue end
							local saved = _savedBodyState[sb]
							if saved ~= nil then
								sb.Visible = saved
							end
							for _, row in ipairs(sb:GetChildren()) do
								if row:IsA("Frame") and row.Name ~= "" then
									restoreFrame(row)
									row.Visible = true
								end
							end
						end
					end
					local tsBody = ts:FindFirstChild("Body"); if tsBody then
						for _, ss in ipairs(tsBody:GetChildren()) do if not ss:IsA("Frame") then continue end
							local hdr = ss:FindFirstChild("Header")
							if hdr then local arrow = hdr:FindFirstChild("Arrow")
								if arrow then local body = ss:FindFirstChild("Body")
									arrow.Text = (body and body.Visible) and "\u{25BC}" or "\u{25B6}" end
							end
						end
					end
				end
				if not isSearch then
					_savedBodyState = {}
					-- Each selected type fills again, so rows hidden by a rule (Framerate in OneShot, a toggle
					-- group's, a Force's by Shape) hide again: a cleared search showed every row.
					if populate then
						for _, entry in ipairs(PropertyCatalog.SECTIONS) do
							local items = ctx[entry.key] or {}
							local fill = populate[entry.populate]
							if #items > 0 and fill then
								fill(items)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end)
		end)
	end
end

--[[
	QOLWiring: the preview snapshots, the Settings panel, the panel toggles and the Blender's Add
	State; wires QOLSearch, QOLPreviews (Size, Time, Hue) and ClipShiftFix.
	(ctx) -> { takeSnapshots, refreshSnapshots, updateFixBanner, refreshClipShifterFilter }
]]

local HueShift = require(script.Parent.Modules.HueShift)

return function(ctx)
	local UI = ctx.UI
	local Connections = ctx.Connections
	local ChangeHistoryService = ctx.ChangeHistoryService
	local UIBuilder = ctx.UIBuilder
	local QOL = ctx.QOL
	local pluginn = ctx.plugin
	local populate = ctx.populate

	local result = {}

	-- Add State for any item with a GraphBlender folder. defaultAttrs: attribute -> default, used
	-- when there is no last state to copy from.
	local function _addBlenderState(item, defaultAttrs)
		local g = item:FindFirstChild("GraphBlender"); if not g then return end
		local maxIdx = 0
		local ordered = {}
		local hasAnyMarker = false
		local allMarkedAuto = true
		for _, child in ipairs(g:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Configuration") then
				local n = tonumber(child.Name) or 0
				if n > maxIdx then maxIdx = n end
				local marker = child:GetAttribute("_AutoTime")
				if marker ~= nil then hasAnyMarker = true end
				if marker ~= true then allMarkedAuto = false end
				table.insert(ordered, { cfg = child, time = child:GetAttribute("Time") or 0 })
			end
		end
		table.sort(ordered, function(a, b) return a.time < b.time end)
		local redistribute
		if hasAnyMarker then
			redistribute = allMarkedAuto
		else
			redistribute = true
			local n = #ordered
			if n > 1 then
				for i, entry in ipairs(ordered) do
					if math.abs(entry.time - (i - 1) / (n - 1)) > 0.005 then redistribute = false; break end
				end
			end
		end
		local last = ordered[#ordered]
		local newCfg = Instance.new("Configuration"); newCfg.Name = tostring(maxIdx + 1)
		for attrName, defaultVal in pairs(defaultAttrs) do
			local seedVal = (last and last.cfg:GetAttribute(attrName)) or defaultVal
			newCfg:SetAttribute(attrName, seedVal)
		end
		newCfg:SetAttribute("_AutoTime", true)
		if redistribute then
			local total = #ordered + 1
			for i, entry in ipairs(ordered) do
				entry.cfg:SetAttribute("Time", (i - 1) / (total - 1))
				entry.cfg:SetAttribute("_AutoTime", true)
			end
			newCfg:SetAttribute("Time", 1.0)
		else
			if last and last.time >= 1.0 - 0.001 then
				local prev = ordered[#ordered - 1]
				local prevTime = (prev and prev.time < 1.0 - 0.001) and prev.time or math.max(0, last.time - 0.1)
				last.cfg:SetAttribute("Time", (prevTime + 1.0) / 2)
			end
			newCfg:SetAttribute("Time", 1.0)
		end
		newCfg.Parent = g
		ctx.util.renumberBlenderStates(item)
	end

	if UI.BlenderAddBtn then
		Connections["BlenderAdd"] = UI.BlenderAddBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			if #ctx.selectedBeams == 0 then return end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Add Blender State")
			for _, b in ipairs(ctx.selectedBeams) do
				_addBlenderState(b, {Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0), Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1,1,1))})
			end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Add Blender State")
			populate.populateBlender(ctx.selectedBeams)
		end)
	end

	if UI.TrailBlenderAddBtn then
		Connections["TrailBlenderAdd"] = UI.TrailBlenderAddBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			if #ctx.selectedTrailEmitters == 0 then return end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Add Trail Blender State")
			for _, t in ipairs(ctx.selectedTrailEmitters) do
				_addBlenderState(t, {Width = NumberSequence.new(1), Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0), Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1,1,1))})
			end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Add Trail Blender State")
			if populate.populateTrailBlender then populate.populateTrailBlender(ctx.selectedTrailEmitters) end
		end)
	end

	require(script.Parent.QOLSearch)(ctx, UI, Connections, populate)

	-- Settings
	local AutoEmitDelay = ctx.AutoEmitDelay

	if UI.AutoEmitDelayBox then
		UI.AutoEmitDelayBox.Text = tostring(AutoEmitDelay)
		Connections["AEDelay"] = UI.AutoEmitDelayBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			local n = tonumber(UI.AutoEmitDelayBox.Text); if n and n >= 0.01 then ctx.AutoEmitDelay = n; pluginn:SetSetting("AutoEmitDelay", n) end
		end)
	end

	-- What the AutoEmit Delay counts from: "After" the effect has played (delay, duration and
	-- lifetime), or "Every" that many seconds from emit to emit (Modules/AutoEmitLoop).
	if UI.AutoEmitModeButton then
		UI.AutoEmitModeButton.Text = ctx.AutoEmitMode
		Connections["AEMode"] = UI.AutoEmitModeButton.Activated:Connect(function()
			ctx.AutoEmitMode = ctx.AutoEmitMode == "Every" and "After" or "Every"
			UI.AutoEmitModeButton.Text = ctx.AutoEmitMode
			pluginn:SetSetting("AutoEmitMode", ctx.AutoEmitMode)
		end)
	end

	-- The box shows a percentage of the base scale (UIBuilder.BASE_UI_SCALE). A value saved against
	-- another base is converted once, so the UI keeps its on-screen size.
	local baseScale = ctx.UIBuilder.BASE_UI_SCALE
	local savedScale = tonumber(pluginn:GetSetting("UIScale"))
	if savedScale and pluginn:GetSetting("UIScaleBase") ~= baseScale then
		savedScale = math.clamp(math.floor(savedScale / baseScale + 0.5), 25, 300)
		pluginn:SetSetting("UIScale", savedScale)
	end
	pluginn:SetSetting("UIScaleBase", baseScale)
	savedScale = savedScale or ctx.UIBuilder.DEFAULT_UI_SCALE_PERCENT
	if UI.UIScale then UI.UIScale.Scale = savedScale / 100 * baseScale end
	if UI.UIScaleBox then
		UI.UIScaleBox.Text = tostring(savedScale)
		Connections["UIScale"] = UI.UIScaleBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			local n = tonumber(UI.UIScaleBox.Text)
			if n and n >= 25 and n <= 300 then
				if UI.UIScale then UI.UIScale.Scale = n / 100 * baseScale end
				pluginn:SetSetting("UIScale", n)
			end
		end)
	end

	-- The engine caps live particles at ctx.Part.MAX_ACTIVE_PARTICLES; 50 to 50000, and a value out
	-- of range restores the box.
	local savedCap = tonumber(pluginn:GetSetting("ParticleCap")) or 1000
	if ctx.Part then ctx.Part.MAX_ACTIVE_PARTICLES = savedCap end
	if UI.ParticleCapBox then
		UI.ParticleCapBox.Text = tostring(savedCap)
		Connections["ParticleCap"] = UI.ParticleCapBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			local n = tonumber(UI.ParticleCapBox.Text)
			if n and n >= 50 and n <= 50000 then
				n = math.floor(n)
				if ctx.Part then ctx.Part.MAX_ACTIVE_PARTICLES = n end
				pluginn:SetSetting("ParticleCap", n)
				UI.ParticleCapBox.Text = tostring(n)
			else
				UI.ParticleCapBox.Text = tostring((ctx.Part and ctx.Part.MAX_ACTIVE_PARTICLES) or 1000)
			end
		end)
	end

	if UI.ResetLayoutButton and UI.ResetLayout then
		Connections["ResetLayout"] = UI.ResetLayoutButton.Activated:Connect(function()
			-- Previews and modal states end first, or they would outlive the reset.
			if ctx.RandomizerWiring and ctx.RandomizerWiring.cancel then
				pcall(function() ctx.RandomizerWiring.cancel() end)
			end

--[[
	RenameTool: renames every selected object by a pattern. The Rename popup (UIBuilder/RenamePanel)
	opens on Actions.RenameSelection (N), previews the names and gives them in one undo step.
	Tokens, in braces or by their shorthands:
	  {name} or $   the object's name now        {n} or *   its number in the order
	  {a}  its letter (a ... z, aa, ab ...)       {A}        the same in capitals
	  {class}  its ClassName                      {parent}   its parent's name
	  \* \$ \{ \\    the character itself; a brace that names no token stays as it is
	Numbers start at Start and go up by Step, zero-padded to Digits.
	  RenameTool.ORDERS                           the order dropdown's choices, the first the default
	  RenameTool.renamable(instances) -> list     what can be renamed (not the game, not a service)
	  RenameTool.order(items, orderName) -> list  a copy in that order (stable)
	  RenameTool.names(items, pattern, options) -> { name per item }   options: start, step, digits
	  RenameTool.letters(index) -> "a" ... "z", "aa" ...
	  RenameTool.apply(items, names) -> renamed   writes the names; one the engine refuses is left
	  RenameTool.wire(ctx)                        the popup's behaviour; sets ctx.UI.openRename
]]

local RenameTool = {}

-- The engine keeps a Name to this many characters.
local LONGEST_NAME = 100
RenameTool.ORDERS = { "Selection order", "Explorer order", "Position X", "Position Y", "Position Z", "Name A-Z" }

function RenameTool.renamable(instances)
	local list = {}
	for _, instance in ipairs(instances) do
		if instance ~= game and instance.Parent ~= game then
			table.insert(list, instance)
		end
	end
	return list
end

-- The indices from the game down to the instance, as the Explorer lists its children.
local function treePath(instance)
	local path = {}
	local node = instance
	while node and node.Parent do
		table.insert(path, 1, table.find(node.Parent:GetChildren(), node) or 0)
		node = node.Parent
	end
	return path
end

local function comesFirst(first, second)
	for index = 1, math.min(#first, #second) do
		if first[index] ~= second[index] then
			return first[index] < second[index]
		end
	end
	return #first < #second
end

-- Where an object stands, for the position orders; nil for one with no place.
local function positionOf(instance)
	if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
		return instance.Position
	elseif instance:IsA("Attachment") then
		return instance.WorldPosition
	elseif instance:IsA("Model") then
		return instance:GetPivot().Position
	end
	return nil
end

-- Text and number runs, so "Part2" sorts before "Part10".
local function naturalKey(name)
	local key = {}
	for text, number in string.gmatch(string.lower(name), "(%D*)(%d*)") do
		if text ~= "" then
			table.insert(key, text)
		end
		if number ~= "" then
			table.insert(key, tonumber(number))
		end
	end
	return key
end

local function naturallyFirst(first, second)
	for index = 1, math.min(#first, #second) do
		local a, b = first[index], second[index]
		if a ~= b then
			if type(a) == type(b) then
				return a < b
			end
			return type(a) == "number"
		end
	end
	return #first < #second
end

function RenameTool.order(items, orderName)
	local keyed = {}
	for index, item in ipairs(items) do
		keyed[index] = { item = item, index = index }
	end
	local before
	if orderName == "Explorer order" then
		for _, entry in ipairs(keyed) do
			entry.key = treePath(entry.item)
		end
		before = comesFirst
	elseif orderName == "Name A-Z" then
		for _, entry in ipairs(keyed) do
			entry.key = naturalKey(entry.item.Name)
		end
		before = naturallyFirst
	elseif orderName == "Position X" or orderName == "Position Y" or orderName == "Position Z" then
		local axis = string.sub(orderName, -1)
		for _, entry in ipairs(keyed) do
			local position = positionOf(entry.item)
			entry.key = position and position[axis]
		end
		-- Objects with no place go last.
		before = function(first, second)
			if first == nil or second == nil then
				return first ~= nil
			end
			return first < second
		end
	end
	if before then
		table.sort(keyed, function(first, second)
			if before(first.key, second.key) then
				return true
			end
			if before(second.key, first.key) then
				return false
			end
			return first.index < second.index
		end)
	end
	local ordered = {}
	for index, entry in ipairs(keyed) do
		ordered[index] = entry.item
	end
	return ordered
end

function RenameTool.letters(index)
	local text = ""
	local left = index
	while left > 0 do
		local digit = (left - 1) % 26
		text = string.char(97 + digit) .. text
		left = (left - 1 - digit) // 26
	end
	return text
end

-- A number as the pattern shows it: whole numbers zero-padded, others as they are.
local function numberText(number, digits)
	if number == math.floor(number) then
		local sign = number < 0 and "-" or ""
		return sign .. string.format("%0" .. digits .. "d", math.abs(number))
	end
	return tostring(number)
end

local function expand(pattern, item, index, options)
	local number = (options.start or 1) + (index - 1) * (options.step or 1)
	local tokens = {
		name = item.Name,
		n = numberText(number, options.digits or 1),
		a = RenameTool.letters(index),
		A = string.upper(RenameTool.letters(index)),
		class = item.ClassName,
		parent = item.Parent and item.Parent.Name or "",
	}
	local out = {}
	local at = 1
	local length = #pattern
	while at <= length do
		local char = string.sub(pattern, at, at)
		if char == "\\" and at < length then
			table.insert(out, string.sub(pattern, at + 1, at + 1))
			at += 2
		elseif char == "*" then
			table.insert(out, tokens.n)
			at += 1
		elseif char == "$" then
			table.insert(out, tokens.name)
			at += 1
		elseif char == "{" then
			local close = string.find(pattern, "}", at + 1, true)
			local word = close and string.sub(pattern, at + 1, close - 1)
			if word and tokens[word] then
				table.insert(out, tokens[word])
				at = close + 1
			else
				table.insert(out, char)
				at += 1
			end
		else
			table.insert(out, char)
			at += 1
		end
	end
	return string.sub(table.concat(out), 1, LONGEST_NAME)
end

function RenameTool.names(items, pattern, options)
	local names = {}
	for index, item in ipairs(items) do
		names[index] = expand(pattern, item, index, options)
	end
	return names
end

function RenameTool.apply(items, names)
	local renamed = 0
	for index, item in ipairs(items) do
		local name = names[index]
		-- An instance the engine keeps its name on (a locked one) refuses the write.
		if name and name ~= "" and pcall(function() item.Name = name end) then
			renamed += 1
		end
	end
	return renamed
end

-- A whole number from a field, or its default when the text is not one.
local function wholeNumber(box, default)
	local value = tonumber(box.Text)
	if value == nil or value ~= value or math.abs(value) > 1e9 then
		return default
	end
	return value
end

function RenameTool.wire(ctx)
	local UI = ctx.UI
	local panel = UI.RenamePanel
	if not panel then
		return
	end
	local Selection = ctx.Selection
	local ChangeHistoryService = ctx.ChangeHistoryService
	local Connections = ctx.Connections
	local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local state = { items = {}, order = RenameTool.ORDERS[1] }

	local function options()
		return {
			start = wholeNumber(UI.RenameStart, 1),
			step = wholeNumber(UI.RenameStep, 1),
			digits = math.clamp(math.floor(wholeNumber(UI.RenameDigits, 1)), 1, 6),
		}
	end

	local function planned()
		local ordered = RenameTool.order(state.items, state.order)
		return ordered, RenameTool.names(ordered, UI.RenamePattern.Text, options())
	end

	local function refresh()
		local ordered, names = planned()
		local rows = UI.RenamePreviewRows
		-- Every row stays, blank when unused: the popup keeps its height.
		for index, row in ipairs(rows) do
			local item = ordered[index]
			row.Text = item and (item.Name .. "  \u{2192}  " .. names[index]) or ""
		end
		local more = #ordered - #rows
		UI.RenameMore.Text = more > 0 and string.format("and %d more", more) or ""
		UI.RenameTitleCount(#ordered)
	end

	local function take()
		state.items = RenameTool.renamable(Selection:Get())
	end

	-- The key that opened the popup is still down, and a focused field would take its letter and
	-- repeats: the pattern field takes focus once every key is up, a second at most.
	local function focusWhenKeysUp()
		local waited = 0
		while #UserInputService:GetKeysPressed() > 0 and waited < 1 do
			waited += task.wait()
		end
		if panel.Visible then
			UI.RenamePattern:CaptureFocus()
		end
	end

	local function open()
		take()
		panel.Visible = true
		refresh()
		task.spawn(focusWhenKeysUp)
	end

	local function apply()
		if #state.items == 0 or UI.RenamePattern.Text == "" then
			return
		end
		local ordered, names = planned()
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Rename")
		RenameTool.apply(ordered, names)
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Rename")
		panel.Visible = false
	end

	UI.openRename = open
	Connections["RenamePattern"] = UI.RenamePattern:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(refresh)
	Connections["RenameEnter"] = UI.RenamePattern.FocusLost:Connect(function(enterPressed)
		if enterPressed then
			apply()
		end
	end)
	for _, key in ipairs({ "RenameStart", "RenameStep", "RenameDigits" }) do
		Connections[key] = UI[key]:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(refresh)
	end
	UI.setRenameOrderChanged(function(text)
		state.order = text
		refresh()
	end)
	Connections["RenameApply"] = UI.RenameApply.Activated:Connect(apply)
	Connections["RenameCancel"] = UI.RenameCancel.Activated:Connect(function()
		panel.Visible = false
	end)
	-- The popup follows the selection while it is open.
	Connections["RenameSelection"] = Selection.SelectionChanged:Connect(function()
		if panel.Visible then
			take()
			refresh()
		end
	end)
	return { refresh = refresh, apply = apply, state = state }
end

return RenameTool

		local collectedPEs = {}
		local collectedTrails = {}
		local collectedBeams = {}
		local collectedHighlights = {}
		local selectedModels = {}
		local transformedSet = {}
		local peSet = {}
		local trailSet = {}
		local beamSet = {}
		local highlightSet = {}
		local modelSet = {}

		local function findTransformedAncestor(inst)
			local cur = inst.Parent
			while cur and cur ~= game do
				if cur:GetAttribute("Transformed") then return cur end
				cur = cur.Parent
			end
			return nil
		end

		-- True only when a transformed item sits strictly between inst and root: a container selected
		-- inside another emitter's RenderTemplate still collects its own PEs, Trails and Beams.
		local function isInsideTransformedBelow(inst, root)
			local cur = inst.Parent
			while cur and cur ~= root and cur ~= game do
				if cur:GetAttribute("Transformed") then return true end
				cur = cur.Parent
			end
			return false
		end

		local function isPluginInternal(inst)
			if inst.Name == "RenderTemplate" then return true end
			if INTERNAL_NAMES[inst.Name] then
				local p = inst.Parent
				if p and p:GetAttribute("Transformed") then return true end
			end
			local cur = inst.Parent
			while cur and cur ~= game do
				if INTERNAL_CONTAINERS[cur.Name] then return true end
				if cur:GetAttribute("Transformed") then return false end
				cur = cur.Parent
			end
			return false
		end

		local function addTransformed(v)
			if not transformedSet[v] then
				transformedSet[v] = true
				table.insert(transformed, v)
			end
		end

		local function addPE(pe)
			if not peSet[pe] then
				peSet[pe] = true
				table.insert(collectedPEs, pe)
			end
		end

		local function addTrail(trail)
			if not trailSet[trail] then
				trailSet[trail] = true
				table.insert(collectedTrails, trail)
			end
		end

		-- A plain Beam: the BeamNative (directAccess) bucket.
		local function addBeam(beam)
			if not beamSet[beam] then
				beamSet[beam] = true
				table.insert(collectedBeams, beam)
			end
		end

		-- A plain Highlight: only the Hue tool edits it (HueShift tints).
		local function addHighlight(highlight)
			if not highlightSet[highlight] then
				highlightSet[highlight] = true
				table.insert(collectedHighlights, highlight)
			end
		end

		local function addModel(m)
			if not modelSet[m] then
				modelSet[m] = true
				table.insert(selectedModels, m)
			end
		end

		-- What `v` holds outside any transformed item below it (the sets keep each once), and whether a
		-- transformed item was among it.
		local function collectBelow(v)
			local found = false
			for _, c in ipairs(v:QueryDescendants(HELD_SELECTOR)) do
				if isInsideTransformedBelow(c, v) then continue end
				if c:IsA('Model') and _isFullyTransformed(c) then
					addModel(c); addTransformed(c); found = true
				elseif isTransformableClass(c) and _isFullyTransformed(c) then
					addTransformed(c); found = true
				elseif c:IsA('ParticleEmitter') then addPE(c)
				elseif c:IsA('Trail') then addTrail(c)
				elseif c:IsA('Beam') then addBeam(c)
				elseif c:IsA('Highlight') then addHighlight(c) end
			end
			return found
		end

		for _, v in pairs(selected) do
			if v:IsA('Model') and _isFullyTransformed(v) then
				addModel(v); addTransformed(v); validParents[v] = v; showEmit = true
			elseif isTransformableClass(v) and _isFullyTransformed(v) then
				addTransformed(v); validParents[v] = v; showEmit = true
			elseif isPluginInternal(v) then
				local ancestor = findTransformedAncestor(v)
				if ancestor then addTransformed(ancestor); validParents[ancestor] = ancestor; showEmit = true end
			elseif v:IsA('ParticleEmitter') then
				addPE(v)
			elseif v:IsA('Trail') then
				-- A plain Trail: the directAccess bucket, and it can be transformed into a TrailEmitter.
				addTrail(v)
				table.insert(parts, v); showTransform = true
			elseif v:IsA('Beam') then
				-- A plain Beam: the BeamNative bucket, and it can be transformed into a Beam emitter.
				addBeam(v)
				table.insert(parts, v); showTransform = true
			elseif v:IsA('Attachment') then
				-- An Attachment holding transformed items is an emit parent, as a Model or Folder is.
				if collectBelow(v) then
					validParents[v] = v; showEmit = true
				end
				if v.Name ~= "RenderTemplate" then
					table.insert(parts, v); showTransform = true
				end
			elseif v:IsA('Model') or v:IsA('Folder') then
				if collectBelow(v) then
					validParents[v] = v; showEmit = true
				elseif v:IsA('Model') and not _isFullyTransformed(v) then
					table.insert(parts, v); showTransform = true end
			else
				if collectBelow(v) then
					showEmit = true; validParents[v] = v
				end
				if v:IsA('Highlight') and not _isFullyTransformed(v) then
					addHighlight(v)
				end
				if (v:IsA('BasePart') or v:IsA('Beam') or v:IsA('Light') or v:IsA('Sound') or v:IsA('Highlight') or v:IsA('Attachment') or v:IsA('Model') or v:IsA('BlurEffect') or v:IsA('BloomEffect') or v:IsA('ColorCorrectionEffect') or v:IsA('Atmosphere') or v:IsA('ImageLabel'))
					and not _isFullyTransformed(v) and v.Name ~= "RenderTemplate" then
					table.insert(parts, v); showTransform = true
				end
			end
		end

		if showEmit then showTransform = false end
		return parts, transformed, validParents, showEmit, showTransform, collectedPEs, collectedTrails, selectedModels, collectedBeams, collectedHighlights
	end

	function Selection.copySettings(item)
		local typeDef = TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(item)
		if not typeDef then return end
		ctx.copiedData = { typeName = TypeRegistry.getTypeName(item), attrs = {} }
		if typeDef.directAccess then
			for propName, _ in pairs(typeDef.properties) do
				ctx.copiedData.attrs[propName] = TypeRegistry.read(item, propName)
			end
		else
			local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
			if not config then ctx.copiedData = nil; return end
			for k, v in pairs(config:GetAttributes()) do ctx.copiedData.attrs[k] = v end
		end
		Log.print("Part-Icles: Copied")
	end

	function Selection.pasteSettings(item)
		if not ctx.copiedData then return end
		local targetType = TypeRegistry.getTypeName(item)
		if targetType ~= ctx.copiedData.typeName then
			Log.print("Part-Icles: Can only paste between same types"); return
		end
		local typeDef = TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(item)
		if typeDef and typeDef.directAccess then
			for k, v in pairs(ctx.copiedData.attrs) do
				if k ~= "Enabled" then TypeRegistry.write(item, k, v) end
			end
		else
			local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
			if not config then return end
			for k, v in pairs(ctx.copiedData.attrs) do
				if k ~= "Enabled" then config:SetAttribute(k, v) end
			end
		end
	end

	-- A selected internal child (PartIcleProperties, RenderTemplate, GraphBlender ...) becomes its
	-- transformed item: an undo would otherwise leave the Configuration selected. Returns the same
	-- table when nothing changes.
	function Selection.redirectInternals(rawSelection)
		local needsRedirect = false
		local result = {}
		local seen = {}
		for _, v in ipairs(rawSelection) do
			local cur, ancestor, internal = v, nil, false
			while cur and cur ~= game do
				if cur:GetAttribute("Transformed") then ancestor = cur; break end
				if INTERNAL_NAMES[cur.Name] then internal = true end
				cur = cur.Parent
			end
			local target = (ancestor and internal) and ancestor or v
			if target ~= v then needsRedirect = true end
			if not seen[target] then seen[target] = true; result[#result+1] = target end
		end
		return needsRedirect and result or rawSelection
	end

	return Selection
end

--[[
	SelectionEditors: closes the Color editor and a row's colour picker, as a Cancel, when the items
	the type sections list change. init(ctx) -> { listed, closeStale }
	SelectionHandler takes listed() before it sorts a selection and calls closeStale(before) after.
	The same items listed again (an undo, a selection put back) keep them open: their Cancel would
	write the values of when they opened, and the picker's waypoint would drop what could be redone.
	The graph editor closes in SelectionHandler on every run. A pick that edits nothing selected (the
	theme editor's colours) opens with ColorPicker:Open's outlivesSelection and stays open.
	Writes the LIVE items an editor was opened for, through that editor's own Cancel.
]]

local PropertyCatalog = require(script.Parent.Modules.PropertyCatalog)

local SECTIONS = PropertyCatalog.SECTIONS

return function(ctx)
	local SelectionEditors = {}

	-- Every section's list as it is now, by ctx key. SelectionHandler replaces the lists and never
	-- empties one in place, so these stay what was listed.
	function SelectionEditors.listed()
		local lists = {}
		for _, entry in ipairs(SECTIONS) do
			lists[entry.key] = ctx[entry.key] or {}
		end
		return lists
	end

	local function changed(before)
		for _, entry in ipairs(SECTIONS) do
			local old = before[entry.key]
			local new = ctx[entry.key]
			if #old ~= #new then
				return true
			end
			for index, item in ipairs(new) do
				if old[index] ~= item then
					return true
				end
			end
		end
		return false
	end

	-- Closes the Color editor (and a stop's picker with it) and a row's colour picker when a list
	-- differs from `before`.
	function SelectionEditors.closeStale(before)
		if not changed(before) then
			return
		end
		local gradient = ctx.colorGradientEditor
		if gradient and gradient:IsOpen() then
			gradient:Close()
		end
		local picker = ctx.colorPicker
		if picker and picker:IsBoundToSelection() then
			picker:Close()
		end
	end

	return SelectionEditors
end
