--[[
	SelectionHandler: what a selection change does: sorts the items into the ctx buckets, fills the
	type sections, shows the panels, and keeps them in sync with attribute writes.
	(ctx, deps) -> handler(selected, preserveFloating)
]]

local EngineAttr = require(script.Parent.Modules.Part.EngineAttr)
local PropertyCatalog = require(script.Parent.Modules.PropertyCatalog)
local initSelectionEditors = require(script.Parent.SelectionEditors)

-- Every type section of the Properties panel: its ctx bucket, frame, title and populate function.
local SECTIONS = PropertyCatalog.SECTIONS

return function(ctx, deps)
	local UI = ctx.UI
	local Connections = ctx.Connections
	local TypeRegistry = ctx.TypeRegistry
	local UIBuilder = ctx.UIBuilder
	local ChangeHistoryService = ctx.ChangeHistoryService
	local util = ctx.util
	local sel = deps.sel
	local populate = deps.populate
	local takeSnapshots = deps.takeSnapshots
	local refreshSnapshots = deps.refreshSnapshots
	local updateFixBanner = deps.updateFixBanner

	local setToggleState = util.setToggleState
	local readProp = function(item, propName) return util.readProp(TypeRegistry, item, propName) end
	local selectionEditors = initSelectionEditors(ctx)

	-- True while a tool slider is dragged: its own preview writes must not re-snapshot and reset it.
	local function isToolPreviewing()
		if UI.ResizePanel and UI.ResizePanel.Visible and UI.ResizeGetVal and UI.ResizeGetVal() ~= 1 then return true end
		if UI.RetimePanel and UI.RetimePanel.Visible and UI.RetimeGetVal and UI.RetimeGetVal() ~= 1 then return true end
		if UI.HuePanel and UI.HuePanel.Visible then
			local h = UI.HueGetVal and UI.HueGetVal() or 0
			local s = UI.SatGetVal and UI.SatGetVal() or 0
			local v = UI.ValGetVal and UI.ValGetVal() or 0
			if h ~= 0 or s ~= 0 or v ~= 0 then return true end
		end
		return false
	end

	local Th = UIBuilder.Theme
	-- The HUD toggle takes a state only when every item agrees.
	local function syncEnableToggle()
		local allEn, allDis = true, true
		for _, v in ipairs(ctx.currentTransformed) do
			local en; if v:GetAttribute("EmissionMode") == "Animate" then en = v:GetAttribute("AnimateLoop") == true
			else en = readProp(v, "Enabled") == true end
			if en then allDis = false else allEn = false end
		end
		for _, pe in ipairs(ctx.selectedPEs) do if pe.Enabled then allDis = false else allEn = false end end
		for _, tr in ipairs(ctx.selectedTrails) do if tr.Enabled then allDis = false else allEn = false end end
		for _, bn in ipairs(ctx.selectedBeamNatives or {}) do if bn.Enabled then allDis = false else allEn = false end end
		if not (allEn or allDis) then
			util.setToggleMixed(UI.ToggleEnableButton)
			UI.EnabledIcon.Visible = false
			UI.StatusDot.BackgroundColor3 = Th.Warning
			return
		end
		setToggleState(UI.ToggleEnableButton, allEn, Th)
		UI.EnabledIcon.Visible = allEn
		UI.StatusDot.BackgroundColor3 = allEn and Th.Green or Th.DarkGold
	end

	-- `preserveFloating` refills the panel for the selection it already shows (an event edit, the hit
	-- filter closing) without closing the graph editor or an open dropdown; otherwise the graph editor
	-- closes on every run. The Color editor and a row's colour picker close when the listed items
	-- change, whatever the flag (SelectionEditors).
	return function(selected, preserveFloating)
		if not preserveFloating then
			if ctx.graphEditor and ctx.graphEditor:IsOpen() then
				ctx.graphEditor:Close()
			end
			UIBuilder.hideDropdownExpansion()
		end
		Connections:removePrefix("Sel_")
		Connections:removePrefix("AttrSync_")
		local listedBefore = selectionEditors.listed()
		ctx.currentParts = {}; ctx.currentTransformed = {}; ctx.currentValidParents = {}
		for _, entry in ipairs(SECTIONS) do
			ctx[entry.key] = {}
		end

		local parts, transformed, validParents, showEmit, showTransform, collectedPEs, collectedTrails, _selectedModels, collectedBeams, collectedHighlights = sel.classifySelection(selected)
		ctx.currentParts = parts; ctx.currentTransformed = transformed; ctx.currentValidParents = validParents

		for _, v in ipairs(transformed) do
			if v:IsA("Beam") then table.insert(ctx.selectedBeams, v)
			elseif v:IsA("Trail") and v:FindFirstChild("PartIcleProperties") then table.insert(ctx.selectedTrailEmitters, v)
			elseif v:IsA("Light") then table.insert(ctx.selectedPointLights, v)
			elseif v:IsA("Sound") then table.insert(ctx.selectedSounds, v)
			elseif v:IsA("Highlight") then table.insert(ctx.selectedHighlights, v)
			-- A Container is an Attachment or a BasePart: before both of their branches.
			elseif v:GetAttribute("IsContainer") then table.insert(ctx.selectedContainers, v)
			elseif v:GetAttribute("IsMatte") then table.insert(ctx.selectedMattes, v)
			-- A Force is an Attachment or a BasePart, a Reactor a Model or a BasePart: before those branches.
			elseif v:GetAttribute("IsForce") then table.insert(ctx.selectedForces, v)
			elseif v:GetAttribute("IsReactor") then table.insert(ctx.selectedReactors, v)
			elseif v:IsA("Attachment") then table.insert(ctx.selectedAttachments, v)
			elseif v:IsA("Model") then table.insert(ctx.selectedModels, v)
			elseif v:IsA("BlurEffect") then table.insert(ctx.selectedBlurs, v)
			elseif v:IsA("BloomEffect") then table.insert(ctx.selectedBlooms, v)
			elseif v:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then table.insert(ctx.selectedColorCorrections, v)
			elseif v:IsA("Atmosphere") then table.insert(ctx.selectedAtmospheres, v)
			elseif v:IsA("ImageLabel") then table.insert(ctx.selectedImageLabels, v)
			-- Lightning, CameraShake, Rocks and Rope before the BasePart catch-all.
			elseif v:IsA("BasePart") and v:GetAttribute("IsLightning") then table.insert(ctx.selectedLightnings, v)
			elseif v:IsA("BasePart") and v:GetAttribute("IsCameraShake") then table.insert(ctx.selectedCameraShakes, v)
			elseif v:IsA("BasePart") and v:GetAttribute("IsRocks") then table.insert(ctx.selectedRocks, v)
			elseif v:IsA("BasePart") and v:GetAttribute("IsRope") then table.insert(ctx.selectedRopes, v)
			elseif v:IsA("BasePart") and v:GetAttribute("IsDistortion") then table.insert(ctx.selectedDistortions, v)
			elseif v:IsA("BasePart") then table.insert(ctx.selectedParts, v) end
		end
		ctx.selectedPEs = collectedPEs or {}
		ctx.selectedTrails = collectedTrails or {}
		ctx.selectedBeamNatives = collectedBeams or {}
		ctx.selectedHighlightNatives = collectedHighlights or {}
		-- After the old AttrSync listeners are gone and before the new ones: what a Cancel writes back
		-- rebuilds no panel.
		selectionEditors.closeStale(listedBefore)

		local showPEOnly = (#ctx.selectedPEs > 0 or #ctx.selectedTrails > 0 or #ctx.selectedBeamNatives > 0) and not showEmit

		task.defer(function()
			if not UI then return end
			local showHud = (showEmit or showPEOnly) and ctx.hudToggleEnabled
			UI.HUDPanel.Visible = showHud
			local directOnly = (#ctx.selectedTrails > 0 or #ctx.selectedBeamNatives > 0) and not showEmit and #ctx.selectedPEs == 0
			if UI.EmitRow then UI.EmitRow.Visible = not directOnly end
			local hasPartIcles = false
			for _, entry in ipairs(SECTIONS) do
				if not entry.native and #ctx[entry.key] > 0 then
					hasPartIcles = true
					break
				end
			end
			-- Plain Beams and Trails can be transformed (into a Beam or TrailEmitter), and so can a Part,
			-- Attachment or Model holding native emitters; ParticleEmitters alone cannot.
			UI.TransformButton.Visible = showTransform and not showEmit
			if ctx.updateTransformMenu then ctx.updateTransformMenu() end
			local hasEditable = hasPartIcles or #ctx.selectedPEs > 0 or #ctx.selectedTrails > 0 or #ctx.selectedBeamNatives > 0
			UI.PropsPanel.Visible = hasEditable and ctx.propsToggleEnabled
			-- A plain Highlight has no properties here, but the Hue tool recolours it.
			if UI.autoTidy then UI.autoTidy(hasEditable or #ctx.selectedHighlightNatives > 0) end
			-- The Clipboard and Shifter stay open across selections; ClipShiftFix hides the rows that do not
			-- apply.

			local function setSectionTitle(sec, baseName, count)
				if not sec then return end
				local hdr = sec:FindFirstChild("Header")
				if hdr then local t = hdr:FindFirstChild("Title"); if t then t.Text = count > 1 and baseName.." ("..count..")" or baseName end end
			end
			for _, entry in ipairs(SECTIONS) do
				local section = UI[entry.section]
				if section then
					local count = #ctx[entry.key]
					section.Visible = count > 0
					setSectionTitle(section, entry.title, count)
				end
			end

			if showEmit and #transformed > 0 then
				local name = transformed[1].Name
				if #transformed > 1 then name = name .. " (+" .. (#transformed-1) .. ")" end
				UI.NameLabel.Text = name
				syncEnableToggle()

				local function getCA(attr)
					if #transformed == 0 then return nil end
					local f = transformed[1]:GetAttribute(attr)
					for i = 2, #transformed do if transformed[i]:GetAttribute(attr) ~= f then return "-" end end
					return f
				end
				local function fmtAttr(v) if v == nil or v == "-" then return "-" end; if typeof(v) == "number" then return string.format("%.4g", v) end; return tostring(v) end
				UI.EmitBox.Text = fmtAttr(getCA("EmitCount"))
				UI.DurationBox.Text = fmtAttr(getCA("EmitDuration"))
				UI.DelayBox.Text = fmtAttr(getCA("EmitDelay"))
				-- Animate plays one cycle in place and ignores EmitCount.
				if UI.EmitRow then
					local allAnimate = #transformed > 0
					for _, t in ipairs(transformed) do
						if t:GetAttribute("EmissionMode") ~= "Animate" then allAnimate = false; break end
					end
					UI.EmitRow.Visible = not allAnimate
				end

				for _, entry in ipairs(SECTIONS) do
					local items = ctx[entry.key]
					local fill = populate[entry.populate]
					if #items > 0 and fill then
						fill(items)
					end
				end
			elseif showPEOnly then
				if #ctx.selectedPEs > 0 then
					local pe = ctx.selectedPEs[1]
					local peName = pe.Name
					if #ctx.selectedPEs > 1 then peName = peName .. " (+" .. (#ctx.selectedPEs-1) .. ")" end
					UI.NameLabel.Text = peName
					local allEn, allDis = true, true
					for _, pe2 in ipairs(ctx.selectedPEs) do if pe2.Enabled then allDis = false else allEn = false end end
					if allEn or allDis then
						UI.EnabledIcon.Visible = allEn; UI.StatusDot.BackgroundColor3 = allEn and Th.Green or Th.DarkGold
						setToggleState(UI.ToggleEnableButton, allEn, Th)
					else syncEnableToggle() end

					local function getPECommon(attr, default)
						local f = ctx.selectedPEs[1]:GetAttribute(attr)
						if f == nil then f = default end
						for i = 2, #ctx.selectedPEs do
							local v = ctx.selectedPEs[i]:GetAttribute(attr)
							if v == nil then v = default end
							if v ~= f then return "-" end
						end
						return f
					end
					local function fmtPE(v) if v == nil or v == "-" then return "-" end; if typeof(v) == "number" then return string.format("%.4g", v) end; return tostring(v) end
					UI.EmitBox.Text = fmtPE(getPECommon("EmitCount", 1))
					UI.DurationBox.Text = fmtPE(getPECommon("EmitDuration", 0))
					UI.DelayBox.Text = fmtPE(getPECommon("EmitDelay", 0))
					populate.populatePEs(ctx.selectedPEs)
					-- The Trail section shows whenever a Trail is selected, so it is filled too.
					if #ctx.selectedTrails > 0 then populate.populateTrails(ctx.selectedTrails) end
					if #ctx.selectedBeamNatives > 0 and populate.populateBeamNatives then populate.populateBeamNatives(ctx.selectedBeamNatives) end
				elseif #ctx.selectedBeamNatives > 0 and #ctx.selectedTrails == 0 then
					local bn = ctx.selectedBeamNatives[1]
					local bnName = bn.Name
					if #ctx.selectedBeamNatives > 1 then bnName = bnName .. " (+" .. (#ctx.selectedBeamNatives-1) .. ")" end
					UI.NameLabel.Text = bnName
					local allEn, allDis = true, true
					for _, b2 in ipairs(ctx.selectedBeamNatives) do if b2.Enabled then allDis = false else allEn = false end end
					if allEn or allDis then
						UI.EnabledIcon.Visible = allEn; UI.StatusDot.BackgroundColor3 = allEn and Th.Green or Th.DarkGold
						setToggleState(UI.ToggleEnableButton, allEn, Th)
					else syncEnableToggle() end
					local function getBNCommon(attr, default)
						local f = ctx.selectedBeamNatives[1]:GetAttribute(attr)
						if f == nil then f = default end
						for i = 2, #ctx.selectedBeamNatives do
							local v2 = ctx.selectedBeamNatives[i]:GetAttribute(attr)
							if v2 == nil then v2 = default end
							if v2 ~= f then return "-" end
						end
						return f
					end
					local function fmtBN(v) if v == nil or v == "-" then return "-" end; if typeof(v) == "number" then return string.format("%.4g", v) end; return tostring(v) end
					if UI.DurationBox then UI.DurationBox.Text = fmtBN(getBNCommon("EmitDuration", 0)) end
					if UI.DelayBox then UI.DelayBox.Text = fmtBN(getBNCommon("EmitDelay", 0)) end
					if populate.populateBeamNatives then populate.populateBeamNatives(ctx.selectedBeamNatives) end
				elseif #ctx.selectedTrails > 0 then
					-- An older Trail without EmitDuration / EmitDelay gets them once: its Lifetime (as text, for the
					-- range) and 0.
					for _, trail in ipairs(ctx.selectedTrails) do
						if trail:GetAttribute("EmitDuration") == nil then
							trail:SetAttribute("EmitDuration", tostring(trail.Lifetime))
						end
						if trail:GetAttribute("EmitDelay") == nil then
							trail:SetAttribute("EmitDelay", 0)
						end
					end
					local trail = ctx.selectedTrails[1]
					local tName = trail.Name
					if #ctx.selectedTrails > 1 then tName = tName .. " (+" .. (#ctx.selectedTrails-1) .. ")" end
					UI.NameLabel.Text = tName
					local allEn, allDis = true, true
					for _, tr2 in ipairs(ctx.selectedTrails) do if tr2.Enabled then allDis = false else allEn = false end end
					if allEn or allDis then
						UI.EnabledIcon.Visible = allEn; UI.StatusDot.BackgroundColor3 = allEn and Th.Green or Th.DarkGold
						setToggleState(UI.ToggleEnableButton, allEn, Th)
					else syncEnableToggle() end
					local function getTrailCommon(attr, default)
						local f = ctx.selectedTrails[1]:GetAttribute(attr)
						if f == nil then f = default end
						for i = 2, #ctx.selectedTrails do
							local v2 = ctx.selectedTrails[i]:GetAttribute(attr)
							if v2 == nil then v2 = default end
							if v2 ~= f then return "-" end
						end
						return f
					end
					local function fmtTr(v) if v == nil or v == "-" then return "-" end; if typeof(v) == "number" then return string.format("%.4g", v) end; return tostring(v) end
					UI.DurationBox.Text = fmtTr(getTrailCommon("EmitDuration", 0))
					UI.DelayBox.Text = fmtTr(getTrailCommon("EmitDelay", 0))
					populate.populateTrails(ctx.selectedTrails)
				end
			end
			if ctx._refreshEmitCode then ctx._refreshEmitCode() end
		end)

		-- Fills every selected type again (after a Randomizer, Clipboard or Explorer write).
		local function repopulateSelected()
			for _, entry in ipairs(SECTIONS) do
				local items = ctx[entry.key]
				local fill = populate[entry.populate]
				if not entry.native and #items > 0 and fill then
					fill(items)
				end
			end
		end
		-- One pending flag per type, so one type's refresh never drops another's.
		local _configSyncPending, _peSyncPending, _trailSyncPending, _beamNativeSyncPending = false, false, false, false
		local graphEditor = ctx.graphEditor
		local colorGradientEditor = ctx.colorGradientEditor
		local colorPicker = ctx.colorPicker
		local function editorsOpen() return (graphEditor and graphEditor:IsOpen()) or (colorGradientEditor and colorGradientEditor:IsOpen()) or (colorPicker and colorPicker:IsOpen()) end
		local _emitSyncPending = false
		local _emitTimingAttrs = {EmitCount=true, EmitDelay=true, EmitDuration=true}
		for i, item in ipairs(transformed) do
			local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
			if config then
				Connections["AttrSync_"..i] = config.AttributeChanged:Connect(function(attrName)
					-- Engine bookkeeping (Enabled windows, _emitGen ...) must not rebuild the panel or reset sliders.
					if EngineAttr.isEngineWrite(config, attrName) then
						if attrName == "Enabled" then syncEnableToggle() end
						return
					end
					if _configSyncPending or editorsOpen() then return end
					_configSyncPending = true
					task.defer(function()
						_configSyncPending = false
						repopulateSelected()
						if attrName == "Enabled" then syncEnableToggle() end
						if refreshSnapshots and not isToolPreviewing() then refreshSnapshots() end
						if ctx._refreshOpt then ctx._refreshOpt() end
					end)
				end)
			end
			Connections["AttrSync_Item_"..i] = item.AttributeChanged:Connect(function(attrName)
				if EngineAttr.isEngineWrite(item, attrName) then
					if attrName == "AnimateLoop" then syncEnableToggle() end
					return
				end
				-- EmitMode (the Type row) rides along: an undo or a paste must reach the row.
				if attrName == "AnimateLoop" or attrName == "EmissionMode" or attrName == "EmitMode" then
					-- The mode, Loop and Enabled rows and the HUD toggle all follow these; every type's fill
					-- recomputes them, screen types included.
					syncEnableToggle()
					if not _configSyncPending then _configSyncPending = true; task.defer(function() _configSyncPending = false
						repopulateSelected()
					end) end
					return
				end
				if not _emitTimingAttrs[attrName] or _emitSyncPending then return end
				_emitSyncPending = true
				task.defer(function()
					_emitSyncPending = false
					-- Randomizer and Clipboard writes refresh the emit boxes here.
					local function getCommon(attr)
						if #transformed == 0 then return nil end
						local f = transformed[1]:GetAttribute(attr)
						for k = 2, #transformed do
							if transformed[k]:GetAttribute(attr) ~= f then return "-" end
						end
						return f
					end
					local function fmt(v) if v == nil or v == "-" then return "-" end; if typeof(v) == "number" then return string.format("%.4g", v) end; return tostring(v) end
					UI.EmitBox.Text = fmt(getCommon("EmitCount"))
					UI.DurationBox.Text = fmt(getCommon("EmitDuration"))
					UI.DelayBox.Text = fmt(getCommon("EmitDelay"))
					if ctx._refreshOpt then ctx._refreshOpt() end
				end)
			end)
		end
		-- Changed fires for native properties, not for attributes, so writes by the Randomizer,
		-- Clipboard or Shifter come through AttributeChanged. The type fills do not touch the shared emit
		-- boxes (EmitBox, DurationBox, DelayBox): these refresh them.
		local function _refreshEmitForPEs()
			if #ctx.selectedPEs == 0 or #ctx.currentTransformed > 0 then return end
			local function getPECommon(attr, default)
				local f = ctx.selectedPEs[1]:GetAttribute(attr)
				if f == nil then f = default end
				for k = 2, #ctx.selectedPEs do
					local v = ctx.selectedPEs[k]:GetAttribute(attr)
					if v == nil then v = default end
					if v ~= f then return "-" end
				end
				return f
			end
			local function fmt(v) if v == nil or v == "-" then return "-" end; if typeof(v) == "number" then return string.format("%.4g", v) end; return tostring(v) end
			if UI.EmitBox then UI.EmitBox.Text = fmt(getPECommon("EmitCount", 1)) end
			if UI.DurationBox then UI.DurationBox.Text = fmt(getPECommon("EmitDuration", 0)) end
			if UI.DelayBox then UI.DelayBox.Text = fmt(getPECommon("EmitDelay", 0)) end
		end
		local function _refreshEmitForTrails()
			if #ctx.selectedTrails == 0 or #ctx.currentTransformed > 0 or #ctx.selectedPEs > 0 then return end
			local function getTrailCommon(attr, default)
				local f = ctx.selectedTrails[1]:GetAttribute(attr)
				if f == nil then f = default end
				for k = 2, #ctx.selectedTrails do
					local v2 = ctx.selectedTrails[k]:GetAttribute(attr)
					if v2 == nil then v2 = default end
					if v2 ~= f then return "-" end
				end
				return f
			end
			local function fmt(v) if v == nil or v == "-" then return "-" end; if typeof(v) == "number" then return string.format("%.4g", v) end; return tostring(v) end
			if UI.DurationBox then UI.DurationBox.Text = fmt(getTrailCommon("EmitDuration", 0)) end
			if UI.DelayBox then UI.DelayBox.Text = fmt(getTrailCommon("EmitDelay", 0)) end
		end
		local function guardedAttrRefresh(inst, refresh)
			return function(attrName)
				if EngineAttr.isEngineWrite(inst, attrName) then return end
				refresh()
			end
		end
		local function _refreshPESelection()
			if _peSyncPending or editorsOpen() then return end
			_peSyncPending = true
			task.defer(function()
				_peSyncPending = false
				if #ctx.selectedPEs > 0 then populate.populatePEs(ctx.selectedPEs) end
				_refreshEmitForPEs()
				if refreshSnapshots and not isToolPreviewing() then refreshSnapshots() end
				if ctx._refreshOpt then ctx._refreshOpt() end
			end)
		end
		local function _refreshTrailSelection()
			if _trailSyncPending or editorsOpen() then return end
			_trailSyncPending = true
			task.defer(function()
				_trailSyncPending = false
				if #ctx.selectedTrails > 0 then populate.populateTrails(ctx.selectedTrails) end
				_refreshEmitForTrails()
				if refreshSnapshots and not isToolPreviewing() then refreshSnapshots() end
				if ctx._refreshOpt then ctx._refreshOpt() end
			end)
		end
		local function _refreshEmitForBeamNatives()
			if #(ctx.selectedBeamNatives or {}) == 0 or #ctx.currentTransformed > 0 or #ctx.selectedPEs > 0 or #ctx.selectedTrails > 0 then return end
			local function getBNCommon(attr, default)
				local f = ctx.selectedBeamNatives[1]:GetAttribute(attr)
				if f == nil then f = default end
				for k = 2, #ctx.selectedBeamNatives do
					local v2 = ctx.selectedBeamNatives[k]:GetAttribute(attr)
					if v2 == nil then v2 = default end
					if v2 ~= f then return "-" end
				end
				return f
			end
			local function fmt(v) if v == nil or v == "-" then return "-" end; if typeof(v) == "number" then return string.format("%.4g", v) end; return tostring(v) end
			if UI.DurationBox then UI.DurationBox.Text = fmt(getBNCommon("EmitDuration", 0)) end
			if UI.DelayBox then UI.DelayBox.Text = fmt(getBNCommon("EmitDelay", 0)) end
		end
		local function _refreshBeamNativeSelection()
			if _beamNativeSyncPending or editorsOpen() then return end
			_beamNativeSyncPending = true
			task.defer(function()
				_beamNativeSyncPending = false
				if #(ctx.selectedBeamNatives or {}) > 0 and populate.populateBeamNatives then populate.populateBeamNatives(ctx.selectedBeamNatives) end
				_refreshEmitForBeamNatives()
				if refreshSnapshots and not isToolPreviewing() then refreshSnapshots() end
				if ctx._refreshOpt then ctx._refreshOpt() end
			end)
		end
		for i, pe in ipairs(ctx.selectedPEs) do
			Connections["AttrSync_PE_"..i] = pe.Changed:Connect(function(propName)
				if propName == "Enabled" then syncEnableToggle() end
				if EngineAttr.isEngineProp(pe, propName) then return end
				_refreshPESelection()
			end)
			Connections["AttrSync_PEAttr_"..i] = pe.AttributeChanged:Connect(guardedAttrRefresh(pe, _refreshPESelection))
		end
		for i, trail in ipairs(ctx.selectedTrails) do
			Connections["AttrSync_Trail_"..i] = trail.Changed:Connect(function(propName)
				if propName == "Enabled" then syncEnableToggle() end
				if EngineAttr.isEngineProp(trail, propName) then return end
				_refreshTrailSelection()
			end)
			Connections["AttrSync_TrailAttr_"..i] = trail.AttributeChanged:Connect(guardedAttrRefresh(trail, _refreshTrailSelection))
		end
		-- Changed: native writes (Enabled from Studio's Properties); AttributeChanged: EmitDuration and
		-- EmitDelay.
		for i, beam in ipairs(ctx.selectedBeamNatives or {}) do
			Connections["AttrSync_BN_"..i] = beam.Changed:Connect(function(propName)
				if propName == "Enabled" then syncEnableToggle() end
				if EngineAttr.isEngineProp(beam, propName) then return end
				_refreshBeamNativeSelection()
			end)
			Connections["AttrSync_BNAttr_"..i] = beam.AttributeChanged:Connect(guardedAttrRefresh(beam, _refreshBeamNativeSelection))
		end

		local function connectAttrBox(box, attr, key)
			Connections["Sel_"..key] = box.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				if box.Text == "-" then return end; local n = tonumber(box.Text)
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Edit " .. attr)
				if n then
					if attr == "EmitDelay" and n < 0 then n = 0; box.Text = "0" end
					for _, v in ipairs(ctx.currentTransformed) do if v:GetAttribute('IsEmitter') then v:SetAttribute(attr, n) end end
					for _, pe2 in ipairs(ctx.selectedPEs) do pe2:SetAttribute(attr, n) end
				end
				-- A Trail's EmitDuration is text: "5,2" is a range.
				if #ctx.selectedTrails > 0 then
					if attr == "EmitDuration" then
						local text = box.Text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
						for _, trail in ipairs(ctx.selectedTrails) do
							trail:SetAttribute("EmitDuration", text)
						end
						if UI.Trail and UI.Trail.Duration and UI.Trail.Duration.input then
							UI.Trail.Duration.input.Text = text
						end
					elseif n then
						for _, trail in ipairs(ctx.selectedTrails) do trail:SetAttribute(attr, n) end
					end
				end
				-- A plain Beam's are numbers.
				if n and #ctx.selectedBeamNatives > 0 then
					for _, beam in ipairs(ctx.selectedBeamNatives) do beam:SetAttribute(attr, n) end
				end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Edit " .. attr)
				if refreshSnapshots then task.defer(refreshSnapshots) end
			end)
		end
		connectAttrBox(UI.EmitBox, "EmitCount", "EC")
		connectAttrBox(UI.DurationBox, "EmitDuration", "ED")
		connectAttrBox(UI.DelayBox, "EmitDelay", "EDL")

		-- The raw selection: items of the first format (Factors or BakedFactors, no Transformed) need Fix too.
		local fixItems = {table.unpack(selected)}
		task.defer(function() if updateFixBanner then updateFixBanner(fixItems) end end)
		task.defer(refreshSnapshots or takeSnapshots)
		if deps.refreshClipShifterFilter then task.defer(deps.refreshClipShifterFilter) end
		if ctx.MotionPreview then task.defer(ctx.MotionPreview.refresh) end
		if ctx.ForceGizmo then task.defer(ctx.ForceGizmo.refresh) end
	end
end

--[[
	The Settings panel's toggles (Auto-Update, Snap Panels In View, Console Output, Workspaces), each
	saved as a plugin setting, on by default. (ctx), from QOLWiring.
]]

local WidgetsMod = require(script.Parent.Modules.UIBuilder.Widgets)
local Log = require(script.Parent.Modules.Part.Log)
local Workspaces = require(script.Parent.Modules.Workspaces)

return function(ctx)
	local UI = ctx.UI
	local Connections = ctx.Connections
	local pluginn = ctx.plugin

	-- Reads `settingKey` (on by default), then passes every change to `apply` and the setting.
	local function wireToggle(toggle, settingKey, apply)
		if not toggle then return end
		local saved = pluginn:GetSetting(settingKey)
		if saved == nil then saved = true end
		local on = saved == true
		if apply then apply(on) end
		toggle:SetAttribute("IsOn", on)
		Connections[settingKey .. "Toggle"] = toggle:GetAttributeChangedSignal("IsOn"):Connect(function()
			local now = toggle:GetAttribute("IsOn") == true
			if apply then apply(now) end
			pluginn:SetSetting(settingKey, now)
		end)
	end

	-- Off lets panels be parked off-screen (Widgets.resolveOverlap's clamp).
	wireToggle(UI.EdgeSnapToggle, "EdgeSnap", function(on) WidgetsMod.EdgeSnapEnabled = on end)
	-- Every Log.print and Log.warn of the plugin and the runtime; error() still shows.
	wireToggle(UI.ConsoleOutputToggle, "ConsoleOutput", function(on) Log.enabled = on end)
	-- OFF brings every overlay the switcher hid back and stops the "/", "=" and "-" keys.
	wireToggle(UI.WorkspacesToggle, "Workspaces", function(on) Workspaces.setEnabled(on) end)
end

--[[
	ThemeWiring: the Theme Editor of every mode but Classic (ThemeWiringClassic). (ctx)
	A session holds a draft document. A change redraws the Preview (ThemeEditor/Showcase) at most
	once a frame, in its own ScreenGui apart from the UI's registries (UIBuilder.buildAside): the
	rest of the UI keeps its theme. Try on UI puts the draft on the whole UI once, by
	UIBuilder:UpdateTheme or by a rebuild (ThemeStore.setDraft) when widgets change
	(ThemeEditor/Catalogue.rebuilds); the session lives in this module, so it outlives the rebuild.
	Apply saves the draft; Cancel and close put back the theme from before.
]]

local initClassic = require(script.Parent.ThemeWiringClassic)

-- { before, draft, built, shown, view, part, opened, previewOpen } or nil. `built`: the document
-- the UI was built from; `shown`: the one it shows; `opened`: section key -> open.
local session = nil
-- The Preview: { gui, scale, panel, aside, position, ms } while it is drawn.
local preview = nil
local PREVIEW_GAP = 12

local function deepCopy(value)
	if type(value) ~= "table" then
		return value
	end
	local copy = {}
	for key, inner in pairs(value) do
		copy[key] = deepCopy(inner)
	end
	return copy
end

local function same(first, second)
	if type(first) ~= "table" or type(second) ~= "table" then
		return first == second
	end
	for key, value in pairs(first) do
		if not same(value, second[key]) then
			return false
		end
	end
	for key in pairs(second) do
		if first[key] == nil then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

return function(ctx)
	local UIBuilder = ctx.UIBuilder
	if UIBuilder.MODE.Structure.Classic then
		session = nil
		UIBuilder.ThemeStore.setDraft(nil)
		initClassic(ctx)
		return
	end

	local UI = ctx.UI
	local Connections = ctx.Connections
	local pluginn = ctx.plugin
	local ThemeStore = UIBuilder.ThemeStore
	local ThemeSchema = UIBuilder.ThemeSchema
	local ThemeCode = UIBuilder.ThemeCode
	local Catalogue = UIBuilder.ThemeEditorCatalogue
	local Rows = UIBuilder.ThemeEditorRows
	local Pick = UIBuilder.ThemeEditorPick
	local T = UIBuilder.Theme
	local MODE = UIBuilder.MODE
	local previewQueued = false

	-- Panels that paint from the theme themselves.
	local function refreshEditors()
		if ctx.graphEditor then
			ctx.graphEditor:RefreshTheme()
		end
		if ctx.colorPicker then
			ctx.colorPicker:RefreshTheme()
		end
		if ctx.colorGradientEditor then
			ctx.colorGradientEditor:RefreshTheme()
		end
		if ctx._refreshFilterHighlights then
			ctx._refreshFilterHighlights()
		end
	end

	-- Whether two documents build different UIs: a setting only a rebuild shows differs.
	local function needsRebuild(first, second)
		for _, entry in ipairs(ThemeSchema.ENTRIES) do
			if Catalogue.rebuilds(entry) and not same(ThemeSchema.value(first, entry.path), ThemeSchema.value(second, entry.path)) then
				return true
			end
		end
		return false
	end

	-- `doc` on the UI as built: its layout, then colours, layers, background, fonts, motion, sounds.
	local function showLive(doc)
		local theme = ThemeStore.fromDocument(doc)
		T.Mode = theme.mode
		T.TextSize = theme.textSize
		T.Doc = ThemeSchema.clean(doc)
		UIBuilder:UpdateTheme(theme.accent, theme.bg, theme.slider, theme.panelAlpha, theme.blobAlpha, theme.font,
			theme.textAccent, theme.blob, theme.scrollBar, nil, theme.bgImage, theme.bgImageTransparency)
		refreshEditors()
	end

	-- What `doc` works out to (mode, roles, structure, metrics, accent), read under its theme.
	local function viewOf(doc)
		return UIBuilder.withTheme(doc, function()
			return {
				mode = MODE.Id,
				roles = table.clone(T),
				structure = table.clone(MODE.Structure),
				layout = table.clone(UIBuilder.LAYOUT),
				hueBase = UIBuilder.hueTurn(),
			}
		end)
	end

	local function draftMode()
		return session.view.mode
	end

	local function placePreview(panel)
		local editor = UI.ThemeEditor
		local scale = preview.scale.Scale
		-- The UI's own ScreenGui: one made this frame has no size yet.
		local screen = UI.ScreenGui.AbsoluteSize.X / scale
		local left = editor.AbsolutePosition.X / scale
		local right = left + editor.AbsoluteSize.X / scale + PREVIEW_GAP
		-- Its own width: a panel made this frame is not laid out yet.
		local width = panel.Size.X.Offset
		-- Right of the editor, or left where the screen ends first; else the roomier side, on screen.
		local leftEdge = left - PREVIEW_GAP - width
		local x = right
		if right + width > screen then
			x = leftEdge >= 0 and leftEdge or (screen - right >= left and screen - width or 0)
		end
		panel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.clamp(x, 0, math.max(screen - width, 0)), editor.AbsolutePosition.Y / scale)
	end

	local function dropPreview()
		if preview then
			if preview.aside then
				UIBuilder.releaseAside(preview.aside)
			end
			preview.gui:Destroy()
			preview = nil
		end
	end

	local showPreview

	-- The last drawing's leftovers go once the new one is in; a moved panel keeps its place.
	local function drawPreview()
		if not session or not session.previewOpen then
			return
		end
		local started = os.clock()
		if not preview or not preview.gui.Parent then
			local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
			gui.Name = UIBuilder.PREVIEW_UI_NAME
			gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
			gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
			local scale = Instance.new("UIScale")
			scale.Parent = gui
			gui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui")
			preview = { gui = gui, scale = scale }
		end
		preview.gui.DisplayOrder = UI.ScreenGui.DisplayOrder + 1
		preview.gui.Enabled = UI.ScreenGui.Enabled
		preview.scale.Scale = UI.UIScale and UI.UIScale.Scale or 1
		local old = {}
		for _, child in ipairs(preview.gui:GetChildren()) do
			if child ~= preview.scale then
				table.insert(old, child)
			end
		end
		local refs, aside = UIBuilder.buildAside(session.draft, function()
			return UIBuilder.ThemeEditorShowcase(preview.gui)
		end)
		if preview.panel then
			preview.position = preview.panel.Position
		end
		for _, child in ipairs(old) do
			child:Destroy()
		end
		if preview.aside then
			UIBuilder.releaseAside(preview.aside)
		end
		preview.panel, preview.aside = refs.ThemePreview, aside
		if preview.position then
			refs.ThemePreview.Position = preview.position
		else
			placePreview(refs.ThemePreview)
		end
		refs.ThemePreviewClose.Activated:Connect(function()
			showPreview(false)
		end)
		preview.ms = (os.clock() - started) * 1000
	end

	-- Edits in one frame draw the Preview once, on the next: a drag sends several events a frame,
	-- each its own resumption, so a deferred call would draw for each.
	local function previewSoon()
		if previewQueued then
			return
		end
		previewQueued = true
		task.delay(0, function()
			previewQueued = false
			drawPreview()
		end)
	end

	function showPreview(show)
		if not session then
			return
		end
		session.previewOpen = show
		UIBuilder.paintSegment(UI.ThemePreviewButton, show)
		if show then
			drawPreview()
		else
			dropPreview()
		end
	end

	local function clearRows(frame)
		for _, child in ipairs(frame:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("GuiObject") then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end

	local render

	local function edited()
		local modeBefore = draftMode()
		session.view = viewOf(session.draft)
		previewSoon()
		if draftMode() ~= modeBefore then
			if not Catalogue.page(session.part, draftMode()) then
				session.part = Catalogue.parts(draftMode())[1].key
			end
			render()
		end
	end

	-- What a setting shows while nothing is stored: its default, or what the draft's mode gives it.
	local function shownValue(entry)
		if entry.default ~= nil then
			return ThemeSchema.value(session.draft, entry.path)
		end
		local role = string.match(entry.path, "^custom%.roles%.(.+)$")
		if role then
			local color = session.view.roles[role]
			return color and UIBuilder.color3ToHex(color) or nil
		end
		local key = string.match(entry.path, "^custom%.structure%.(.+)$")
		if key then
			local value = session.view.structure[key]
			return typeof(value) == "EnumItem" and value.Name or value
		end
		key = string.match(entry.path, "^custom%.metrics%.(.+)$")
		return key and session.view.layout[key] or nil
	end

	local function pickColor(color, onPicked)
		local picker = ctx.colorPicker
		if not picker then
			return
		end
		picker:SetOnColorChanged(onPicked)
		picker:SetOnOK(function() end)
		picker:SetOnCancel(function()
			onPicked(color)
		end)
		-- A theme colour is nothing of the selection: the pick outlives a change of it.
		picker:Open(color, "Theme colour", true)
	end

	local function bindingFor(entry)
		return {
			get = function()
				return ThemeSchema.get(session.draft, entry.path)
			end,
			shown = function()
				return shownValue(entry)
			end,
			set = function(value)
				if value ~= nil then
					value = ThemeSchema.validate(entry, value)
					if value == nil then
						return
					end
				end
				ThemeSchema.set(session.draft, entry.path, value)
				edited()
			end,
			pickColor = pickColor,
		}
	end

	local function renderParts()
		local list = UI.ThemePartsList
		clearRows(list)
		local group = nil
		for index, part in ipairs(Catalogue.parts(draftMode())) do
			if part.group ~= group and part.group then
				Rows.group(list, part.group, index * 2 - 1)
			end
			group = part.group
			local button = Rows.part(list, part, part.key == session.part, index * 2)
			if button then
				button.Activated:Connect(function()
					session.part = part.key
					render()
				end)
			end
		end
	end

	local function renderPage()
		local page = UI.ThemePage
		clearRows(page)
		local content = Catalogue.page(session.part, draftMode())
		if not content then
			return
		end
		Rows.pageHeading(page, content.title, content.note)
		for index, section in ipairs(content.sections) do
			if section.follows and ThemeSchema.value(session.draft, section.follows.path) ~= true then
				continue
			end
			local ticked = section.toggle and ThemeSchema.value(session.draft, section.toggle.path) == true
			local opened = session.opened[section.key]
			if opened == nil then
				opened = ticked or not section.toggle
			end
			local body = Rows.section(page, section, index * 10, opened, ticked, function(on)
				ThemeSchema.set(session.draft, section.toggle.path, on)
				session.opened[section.key] = on
				edited()
				renderPage()
			end, function()
				session.opened[section.key] = not opened
				renderPage()
			end)
			for order, entry in ipairs(section.entries) do
				Rows.setting(body, entry, order, bindingFor(entry))
			end
		end
	end

	-- The accent turned through the whole circle; the handle at the draft's turn.
	local HUE_STOPS = 12
	local function renderHue()
		local base = session.view.hueBase
		local turn = tonumber(ThemeSchema.value(session.draft, "hue")) or 0
		if base then
			local ColorMath = UIBuilder.ThemeModes.ColorMath
			local keypoints = {}
			for stop = 0, HUE_STOPS do
				table.insert(keypoints, ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(stop / HUE_STOPS, ColorMath.turnHue(base, stop * 360 / HUE_STOPS)))
			end
			UI.ThemeHueRamp.Color = ColorSequence.new(keypoints)
			UI.ThemeHueHandle.BackgroundColor3 = ColorMath.turnHue(base, turn)
		end
		UI.ThemeHueHandle.Position = UDim2.fromScale(turn / 360, 0.5)
		if not UI.ThemeHueBox:IsFocused() then
			UI.ThemeHueBox.Text = turn == 0 and "0°" or string.format("+%d°", turn)
		end
	end

	local function renderHeader()
		UI.ThemeInvertButton.Text = ThemeSchema.value(session.draft, "invert") and "Inverted" or "Invert"
		renderHue()
		UI.ModeDropdown.Text = ThemeSchema.value(session.draft, "mode")
		UI.TextSizeDropdown.Text = tostring(ThemeSchema.value(session.draft, "textSize"))
		UI.ThemeNameBox.Text = ThemeSchema.value(session.draft, "name")
		UI.ThemeBaseDropdown.Text = ThemeSchema.value(session.draft, "custom.base")
		local roles = session.view.roles
		local matching = UIBuilder.presetMatching({
			accent = roles.InputAccent, bg = roles.InputBg, blob = roles.InputBlob, slider = roles.InputSlider, scrollBar = roles.InputScrollBar,
		})
		UI.ThemePresetDropdown.Text = matching or "Custom"
	end

	function render()
		renderHeader()
		renderParts()
		renderPage()
	end

	local function endSession()
		Pick.stop()
		session = nil
		ThemeStore.setDraft(nil)
		UI.ThemeEditor.Visible = false
		dropPreview()
	end

	local function apply()
		local draft = ThemeSchema.clean(session.draft)
		local rebuild = needsRebuild(draft, session.built)
		-- The UI shows the theme from before, or an older try: it takes the draft now.
		if not rebuild and not same(draft, session.shown) then
			showLive(draft)
		end
		ThemeStore.apply(ThemeStore.fromDocument(draft))
		pluginn:SetSetting("ThemeJSON", ThemeStore.encode())
		endSession()
		if rebuild and ctx.restartUI then
			ctx.restartUI()
		end
	end

	local function cancel()
		if not session then
			UI.ThemeEditor.Visible = false
			return
		end
		local before = session.before
		local rebuild = needsRebuild(before, session.built)
		local shown = session.shown
		endSession()
		if rebuild and ctx.restartUI then
			ThemeStore.apply(ThemeStore.fromDocument(before))
			ctx.restartUI()
		elseif not same(shown, before) then
			-- Shown first, so UpdateTheme sees the colours change from the tried draft's.
			showLive(before)
			ThemeStore.apply(ThemeStore.fromDocument(before))
		end
	end

	local function open()
		if not session then
			local current = ThemeStore.document()
			local first = nil
			for _, part in ipairs(Catalogue.parts(MODE.Id)) do
				first = first or part.key
			end
			session = {
				before = current, draft = deepCopy(current), built = deepCopy(current), shown = deepCopy(current),
				view = viewOf(current), part = first, opened = {}, previewOpen = true,
			}
		end
		if not Catalogue.page(session.part, draftMode()) then
			session.part = Catalogue.parts(draftMode())[1].key
		end
		render()
		UI.ThemeEditor.Visible = true
		UIBuilder.paintSegment(UI.ThemePreviewButton, session.previewOpen)
		-- Once the editor is laid out, so the Preview opens beside it.
		task.defer(drawPreview)
	end

	-- Opens the editor on a part (Catalogue key): Pick and the Studio checks go through it.
	UI.showThemePart = function(key)
		open()
		if Catalogue.page(key, draftMode()) then
			session.part = key
			render()
		end
	end

	UI.toggleThemeEditor = function()
		if UI.ThemeEditor.Visible then
			cancel()
		else
			open()
		end
	end
	if UI.EditThemeButton then
		Connections["OpenThemeEditor"] = UI.EditThemeButton.Activated:Connect(open)
	end
	Connections["TE_Apply"] = UI.ApplyTheme.Activated:Connect(apply)
	Connections["TE_Cancel"] = UI.CancelTheme.Activated:Connect(cancel)
	Connections["TE_Close"] = UI.ThemeCloseButton.Activated:Connect(cancel)
	-- Pick: the next press on the UI opens the part that edits it (outside Custom, the colours).
	local function partOf(surface)
		if draftMode() == "Custom" then
			return Catalogue.partOfSurface(surface)
		end
		return "Colours"
	end
	local function labelOf(key)
		for _, part in ipairs(Catalogue.parts(draftMode())) do
			if part.key == key then
				return part.label
			end
		end
		return key
	end
	UI.startThemePick = function()
		UI.ThemePickButton.Text = "Picking"
		Pick.start(UI.ScreenGui, UIBuilder.getThemed(), {
			partOf = partOf,
			label = labelOf,
			onPicked = UI.showThemePart,
			onDone = function()
				UI.ThemePickButton.Text = "Pick"
			end,
		})
	end
	Connections["TE_Pick"] = UI.ThemePickButton.Activated:Connect(UI.startThemePick)

	-- The draft's other polarity, previewed like a colour (ThemeModes/Invert).
	UI.toggleThemeInvert = function()
		ThemeSchema.set(session.draft, "invert", ThemeSchema.value(session.draft, "invert") ~= true or nil)
		edited()
		renderHeader()
		renderPage()
	end
	Connections["TE_Invert"] = UI.ThemeInvertButton.Activated:Connect(UI.toggleThemeInvert)

	-- The draft's colours turned around the hue circle (ThemeSchema "hue", 0 to 359).
	local function previewHue()
		if not session then
			return
		end
		edited()
		renderHeader()
	end
	UI.setThemeHue = function(degrees)
		open()
		local turn = math.floor(degrees + 0.5) % 360
		ThemeSchema.set(session.draft, "hue", turn ~= 0 and turn or nil)
		renderHue()
	end
	local draggingHue = false
	local function hueAt(x)
		local strip = UI.ThemeHueStrip
		local share = math.clamp((x - strip.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(strip.AbsoluteSize.X, 1), 0, 1)
		-- The right end is a full turn: the theme as made.
		return share >= 1 and 0 or share * 360
	end
	Connections["TE_HuePress"] = UI.ThemeHueCatcher.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			draggingHue = true
			UI.setThemeHue(hueAt(input.Position.X))
			previewHue()
		end
	end)
	Connections["TE_HueDrag"] = game:GetService("UserInputService").InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if draggingHue and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
			UI.setThemeHue(hueAt(input.Position.X))
			previewHue()
		end
	end)
	Connections["TE_HueRelease"] = game:GetService("UserInputService").InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if draggingHue and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
			draggingHue = false
			previewHue()
		end
	end)
	Connections["TE_HueBox"] = UI.ThemeHueBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
		local typed = tonumber((string.gsub(UI.ThemeHueBox.Text, "[^%d%.%-]", "")))
		if typed then
			UI.setThemeHue(typed)
			previewHue()
		else
			renderHue()
		end
	end)
	Connections["TE_HueReset"] = UI.ThemeHueReset.Activated:Connect(function()
		UI.setThemeHue(0)
		previewHue()
	end)

	-- Sets one setting as its row does, for the Studio checks: typing cannot be simulated in edit mode.
	UI.setThemeSetting = function(path, value)
		open()
		bindingFor(ThemeSchema.byPath[path]).set(value)
		renderHeader()
	end

	-- The Studio checks call these: a click cannot be simulated in edit mode.
	UI.toggleThemePreview = function()
		showPreview(not session.previewOpen)
	end
	Connections["TE_Preview"] = UI.ThemePreviewButton.Activated:Connect(UI.toggleThemePreview)
	-- The Preview's ScreenGui follows the UI's being shown and its scale.
	Connections["TE_PreviewShown"] = UI.ScreenGui:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
		if preview then
			preview.gui.Enabled = UI.ScreenGui.Enabled
		end
	end)
	if UI.UIScale then
		Connections["TE_PreviewScale"] = UI.UIScale:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Scale"):Connect(function()
			if preview then
				preview.scale.Scale = UI.UIScale.Scale
			end
		end)
	end
	-- The last Preview's draw time in ms, for the checks.
	UI.themePreviewMs = function()
		return preview and preview.ms
	end

	-- Unsaved: Cancel puts back the theme from before. Later edits show on the Preview only.
	UI.tryThemeOnUI = function()
		if not session then
			return
		end
		local draft = ThemeSchema.clean(session.draft)
		session.shown = deepCopy(draft)
		ThemeStore.setDraft(session.shown)
		if needsRebuild(draft, session.built) and ctx.restartUI then
			session.built = deepCopy(draft)
			ctx.restartUI()
			return
		end
		showLive(draft)
	end
	Connections["TE_Try"] = UI.TryTheme.Activated:Connect(UI.tryThemeOnUI)

	-- Back to the default theme (Ashen Grace), name and all.
	Connections["TE_Reset"] = UI.ResetTheme.Activated:Connect(function()
		session.draft = ThemeStore.defaultDocument()
		session.opened = {}
		edited()
		render()
	end)

	-- Copy selects the code in the box: a plugin cannot write the clipboard, Ctrl+C can.
	Connections["TE_Copy"] = UI.CopyTheme.Activated:Connect(function()
		local code = ThemeCode.encode(ThemeSchema.clean(session.draft))
		UI.ThemeCodeBox.Text = code
		UI.ThemeCodeBox:CaptureFocus()
		UI.ThemeCodeBox.CursorPosition = #code + 1
		UI.ThemeCodeBox.SelectionStart = 1
	end)

	Connections["TE_Import"] = UI.ImportTheme.Activated:Connect(function()
		local theme = ThemeStore.decode(UI.ThemeCodeBox.Text)
		if not theme or not session then
			return
		end
		session.draft = deepCopy(theme.doc)
		session.opened = {}
		edited()
		render()
	end)

	UI.ModeOnChanged(function(name)
		ThemeSchema.set(session.draft, "mode", name)
		if name == "Classic" then
			apply()
			return
		end
		edited()
	end)
	UI.TextSizeOnChanged(function(size)
		ThemeSchema.set(session.draft, "textSize", tonumber(size))
		edited()
	end)
	UI.ThemeBaseOnChanged(function(name)
		ThemeSchema.set(session.draft, "custom.base", name)
		edited()
	end)
	UI.ThemePresetOnChanged(function(name)
		local preset = UIBuilder.presetNamed(name)
		if not preset then
			return
		end
		for key, color in pairs({ accent = preset.accent, bg = preset.bg, blob = preset.blob, slider = preset.slider, scrollBar = preset.scrollBar, textAccent = preset.textAccent }) do
			ThemeSchema.set(session.draft, key, UIBuilder.color3ToHex(color))
		end
		ThemeSchema.set(session.draft, "font", preset.font)
		edited()
		renderPage()
	end)
	Connections["TE_Name"] = UI.ThemeNameBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
		ThemeSchema.set(session.draft, "name", ThemeSchema.validate(ThemeSchema.byPath.name, UI.ThemeNameBox.Text) or "")
	end)

	-- A rebuild mid-session (a size change, or the mode) opens the editor again where it was.
	if session then
		open()
	end
end

--[[
	ThemeWiringClassic: the Classic mode's theme editor (BuildThemeEditor's Classic layout): fill,
	live preview, swatches, Apply / Cancel / Reset, presets, export and import. (ctx), from ThemeWiring.
	Colours and the title font preview through UIBuilder:UpdateTheme. Mode and text size change
	sizes, so they wait for Apply, which saves the theme and rebuilds the UI (ctx.restartUI).
	UIBuilder.ThemeStore.load reads the saved theme before Build. Export writes the short code
	(ThemeStore.exportCode); Import takes it or an older JSON code.
]]

return function(ctx)
	local UI = ctx.UI
	local Connections = ctx.Connections
	local UIBuilder = ctx.UIBuilder
	local HttpService = ctx.HttpService
	local pluginn = ctx.plugin

	local ThemeStore = UIBuilder.ThemeStore
	local ThemeModes = UIBuilder.ThemeModes
	local hexToColor3 = UIBuilder.hexToColor3
	local color3ToHex = UIBuilder.color3ToHex
	local T = UIBuilder.Theme
	local themeSnapshot = nil

	-- { editor row, the saved colour it edits, picker title }
	local COLOR_ROWS = {
		{ ref = UI.AccentColor, input = "InputAccent", title = "Accent Color", key = "Accent" },
		{ ref = UI.BgColor, input = "InputBg", title = "Background Color", key = "Bg" },
		{ ref = UI.BlobColor, input = "InputBlob", title = "Field Color", key = "Blob" },
		{ ref = UI.SliderColor, input = "InputSlider", title = "Slider Color", key = "Slider" },
		{ ref = UI.ScrollBarColor, input = "InputScrollBar", title = "Scroll Bar Color", key = "ScrollBar" },
		{ ref = UI.TextColor, input = "TextAccent", title = "Text Color", key = "Text" },
	}

	-- Panels that paint from the theme themselves.
	local function refreshEditors()
		if ctx.graphEditor then
			ctx.graphEditor:RefreshTheme()
		end
		if ctx.colorPicker then
			ctx.colorPicker:RefreshTheme()
		end
		if ctx.colorGradientEditor then
			ctx.colorGradientEditor:RefreshTheme()
		end
		if ctx._refreshFilterHighlights then
			ctx._refreshFilterHighlights()
		end
	end

	local function detectPreset()
		return UIBuilder.presetMatching({
			accent = T.InputAccent, bg = T.InputBg, blob = T.InputBlob,
			slider = T.InputSlider, scrollBar = T.InputScrollBar,
		}) or "Custom"
	end

	local function populateThemeEditor()
		for _, row in ipairs(COLOR_ROWS) do
			if row.ref then
				row.ref.hex.Text = color3ToHex(T[row.input])
				row.ref.swatch.BackgroundColor3 = T[row.input]
			end
		end
		if UI.PanelOpacityBox then
			UI.PanelOpacityBox.Text = tostring(math.floor(T.InputPanelAlpha * 100 + 0.5))
		end
		if UI.BlobOpacityBox then
			UI.BlobOpacityBox.Text = tostring(math.floor(T.InputBlobAlpha * 100 + 0.5))
		end
		if UI.BgImageBox then
			UI.BgImageBox.Text = T.BgImage or ""
		end
		if UI.BgImageOpacityBox then
			UI.BgImageOpacityBox.Text = tostring(math.floor((T.BgImageTransparency or 1) * 100 + 0.5))
		end
		if UI.FontDropdown then
			UI.FontDropdown.Text = T.Font.Name
		end
		if UI.ModeDropdown then
			UI.ModeDropdown.Text = T.Mode
		end
		if UI.TextSizeDropdown then
			UI.TextSizeDropdown.Text = tostring(T.TextSize)
		end
		if UI.PresetDropdownLbl then
			UI.PresetDropdownLbl.Text = detectPreset()
		end
	end

	local function fieldColor(ref)
		return ref and hexToColor3(ref.hex.Text)
	end

	-- A percentage box as a 0..1 value; nil when the box is absent (not Classic) or not a number.
	local function fieldAlpha(box)
		local percent = box and tonumber(box.Text)
		return percent and math.clamp(percent / 100, 0, 1) or nil
	end

	local function applyPreviewFromFields()
		local bgImage = UI.BgImageBox and ThemeStore.normalizeAssetId(UI.BgImageBox.Text)
		local bgAlphaPercent = UI.BgImageOpacityBox and tonumber(UI.BgImageOpacityBox.Text)
		UIBuilder:UpdateTheme(
			fieldColor(UI.AccentColor), fieldColor(UI.BgColor), fieldColor(UI.SliderColor),
			fieldAlpha(UI.PanelOpacityBox), fieldAlpha(UI.BlobOpacityBox),
			UI.FontDropdown and UI.FontDropdown.Text,
			fieldColor(UI.TextColor), fieldColor(UI.BlobColor), fieldColor(UI.ScrollBarColor),
			nil,
			bgImage,
			bgAlphaPercent and math.clamp(bgAlphaPercent / 100, 0, 1) or nil
		)
		if bgImage and UI.BgImageBox and UI.BgImageBox.Text ~= bgImage then
			UI.BgImageBox.Text = bgImage
		end
		for _, row in ipairs(COLOR_ROWS) do
			local color = fieldColor(row.ref)
			if color then
				row.ref.swatch.BackgroundColor3 = color
			end
		end
		refreshEditors()
	end

	local function openColorPicker(colorRef, title)
		if not ctx.colorPicker then
			return
		end
		local previous = hexToColor3(colorRef.hex.Text)
		ctx.colorPicker:SetOnColorChanged(function(newColor)
			colorRef.hex.Text = color3ToHex(newColor)
			colorRef.swatch.BackgroundColor3 = newColor
			applyPreviewFromFields()
		end)
		ctx.colorPicker:SetOnOK(function() end)
		ctx.colorPicker:SetOnCancel(function()
			if previous then
				colorRef.hex.Text = color3ToHex(previous)
				colorRef.swatch.BackgroundColor3 = previous
				applyPreviewFromFields()
			end
		end)
		-- A theme colour is nothing of the selection: the pick outlives a change of it.
		ctx.colorPicker:Open(previous or Color3.new(1, 1, 1), title, true)
	end

	for _, row in ipairs(COLOR_ROWS) do
		local ref = row.ref
		if ref then
			Connections["TE_" .. row.key .. "Swatch"] = ref.swatch.Activated:Connect(function()
				openColorPicker(ref, row.title)
			end)
			Connections["TE_" .. row.key] = ref.hex.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				local color = hexToColor3(ref.hex.Text)
				if color then
					ref.hex.Text = color3ToHex(color)
					ref.swatch.BackgroundColor3 = color
				end
				applyPreviewFromFields()
			end)
		end
	end

	if UI.PanelOpacityBox then
		Connections["TE_PanelOp"] = UI.PanelOpacityBox.FocusLost:Connect(applyPreviewFromFields)
	end
	if UI.BlobOpacityBox then
		Connections["TE_BlobOp"] = UI.BlobOpacityBox.FocusLost:Connect(applyPreviewFromFields)
	end
	if UI.BgImageBox then
		Connections["TE_BgImage"] = UI.BgImageBox.FocusLost:Connect(applyPreviewFromFields)
	end
	if UI.BgImageOpacityBox then
		Connections["TE_BgImageOp"] = UI.BgImageOpacityBox.FocusLost:Connect(applyPreviewFromFields)
	end
	if UI.FontDropdownOnChanged then
		UI.FontDropdownOnChanged(applyPreviewFromFields)
	end

	-- The shortcut goes through UI.toggleThemeEditor, so it snapshots too.
	local function openThemeEditor()
		themeSnapshot = UIBuilder:SnapshotTheme()
		populateThemeEditor()
		UI.ThemeEditor.Visible = true
	end

	local function revertAndClose()
		if themeSnapshot then
			UIBuilder:RestoreTheme(themeSnapshot)
		end
		refreshEditors()
		themeSnapshot = nil
		UI.ThemeEditor.Visible = false
	end

	UI.toggleThemeEditor = function()
		if UI.ThemeEditor and UI.ThemeEditor.Visible then
			revertAndClose()
		else
			openThemeEditor()
		end
	end
	if UI.EditThemeButton then
		Connections["OpenThemeEditor"] = UI.EditThemeButton.Activated:Connect(openThemeEditor)
	end

	-- A picker opened from a property stays open: it belongs to whoever opened it.
	if UI.ApplyTheme then
		Connections["TE_Apply"] = UI.ApplyTheme.Activated:Connect(function()
			applyPreviewFromFields()
			local mode = UI.ModeDropdown and ThemeModes.get(UI.ModeDropdown.Text).Id or T.Mode
			local textSize = UI.TextSizeDropdown and ThemeModes.textSize(tonumber(UI.TextSizeDropdown.Text)) or T.TextSize
			-- Custom's structure and metrics change sizes, as a mode or text size does: rebuilt too.
			local customBefore = themeSnapshot and themeSnapshot.Doc and HttpService:JSONEncode(themeSnapshot.Doc.custom or {}) or ""
			local customNow = HttpService:JSONEncode(T.Doc.custom or {})
			local needsRebuild = mode ~= T.Mode or textSize ~= T.TextSize or (mode == "Custom" and customBefore ~= customNow)
			T.Mode = mode
			T.TextSize = textSize
			pluginn:SetSetting("ThemeJSON", ThemeStore.encode())
			themeSnapshot = nil
			UI.ThemeEditor.Visible = false
			if needsRebuild and ctx.restartUI then
				ctx.restartUI()
			end
		end)
	end

	if UI.CancelTheme then
		Connections["TE_Cancel"] = UI.CancelTheme.Activated:Connect(revertAndClose)
	end

	local function applyPreset(preset)
		UIBuilder:UpdateTheme(preset.accent, preset.bg, preset.slider, preset.panelAlpha, preset.blobAlpha, preset.font, preset.textAccent, preset.blob, preset.scrollBar)
		refreshEditors()
		populateThemeEditor()
	end

	-- The default theme (Ashen Grace, a Custom theme) into the fields: Apply saves it and rebuilds,
	-- Cancel puts back what was there.
	if UI.ResetTheme then
		Connections["TE_Reset"] = UI.ResetTheme.Activated:Connect(function()
			local default = ThemeStore.decode(UIBuilder.DEFAULT_THEME_CODE)
			ThemeStore.apply(default)
			refreshEditors()
			populateThemeEditor()
			if UI.ModeDropdown then
				UI.ModeDropdown.Text = default.mode
			end
			if UI.TextSizeDropdown then
				UI.TextSizeDropdown.Text = tostring(default.textSize)
			end
		end)
	end

	if UI.PresetOnChanged then
		UI.PresetOnChanged(function(name)
			for _, preset in ipairs(UIBuilder.THEME_PRESETS or {}) do
				if preset.name == name then

--[[
	The Enable toggle's one body, for the toolbar button and the shortcut: EnabledIcon, StatusDot,
	the sections' toggles and Animate mode's timed auto-off. Sets ctx.UI.toggleEnableAll.
]]

return function(ctx, deps)
	local UI = ctx.UI
	local Connections = ctx.Connections
	local UIBuilder = deps.UIBuilder
	local TypeRegistry = deps.TypeRegistry
	local Part = deps.Part
	local setToggleState = deps.setToggleState

	local ChangeHistoryService = ctx.ChangeHistoryService

	-- Natives inside a RenderTemplate are here only when selected themselves. Their Enabled is
	-- authored data that clones inherit (_restoreAuthoredEnabled), so it is written as the HUD boxes do.
	local function applyToggleEnableState(newState)
		local transformed = {table.unpack(ctx.currentTransformed)}
		local pes = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedPEs or {})}
		local trails = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedTrails or {})}
		local beamNatives = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedBeamNatives or {})}
		task.defer(function()
			-- One undo step for the whole toggle.
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Toggle Enable")
			local Th = UIBuilder.Theme
			for _, v in ipairs(transformed) do
				if v:GetAttribute("EmissionMode") == "Animate" then
					v:SetAttribute("AnimateLoop", newState)
					if newState and not Part.ActiveAnimates[v] then Part:EmitAnimate(v) end
					if newState then
						local dur = v:GetAttribute("EmitDuration") or 0
						if dur > 0 then
							-- A newer on/off cycle makes an older scheduled off do nothing.
							local gen = (v:GetAttribute("_autoOffGen") or 0) + 1
							v:SetAttribute("_autoOffGen", gen)
							task.delay(dur, function()
								if v.Parent
									and v:GetAttribute("AnimateLoop")
									and v:GetAttribute("_autoOffGen") == gen
								then
									v:SetAttribute("AnimateLoop", false)
								end
							end)
						end
					end
				else
					local cfg = TypeRegistry.getConfig(v)
					if cfg then cfg:SetAttribute("Enabled", newState) end
				end
			end
			for _, pe in ipairs(pes) do pe.Enabled = newState end
			for _, trail in ipairs(trails) do trail.Enabled = newState end
			for _, beam in ipairs(beamNatives) do beam.Enabled = newState end
			for _, k in ipairs({"Trail","BeamNative","Part","Beam","PointLight","Sound","Attachment","Model","Blur","Bloom","ColorCorrection","Atmosphere","ImageLabel","PE"}) do
				local s = UI[k]
				if s and s.Enabled and s.Enabled.toggle then setToggleState(s.Enabled.toggle, newState, Th) end
				if s and s.AnimateLoop and s.AnimateLoop.toggle then setToggleState(s.AnimateLoop.toggle, newState, Th) end
			end
			UI.EnabledIcon.Visible = newState
			UI.StatusDot.BackgroundColor3 = newState and Th.Green or Th.DarkGold
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Toggle Enable")
		end)
	end

	-- Any item on turns all off, else all on; the toolbar's IsOn follows before the writes.
	UI.toggleEnableAll = function()
		local transformed = ctx.currentTransformed or {}
		local pes = ctx.selectedPEs or {}
		local trails = ctx.selectedTrails or {}
		local beamNatives = ctx.selectedBeamNatives or {}
		if #transformed == 0 and #pes == 0 and #trails == 0 and #beamNatives == 0 then return end
		local anyOn = false
		for _, v in ipairs(transformed) do
			if v:GetAttribute("EmissionMode") == "Animate" then
				if v:GetAttribute("AnimateLoop") == true then anyOn = true; break end
			else
				local cfg = TypeRegistry.getConfig(v)
				if cfg and cfg:GetAttribute("Enabled") == true then anyOn = true; break end
			end
		end
		if not anyOn then for _, pe in ipairs(pes) do if pe.Enabled then anyOn = true; break end end end
		if not anyOn then for _, t in ipairs(trails) do if t.Enabled then anyOn = true; break end end end
		if not anyOn then for _, b in ipairs(beamNatives) do if b.Enabled then anyOn = true; break end end end
		local newState = not anyOn
		pcall(function() UI.ToggleEnableButton:SetAttribute("IsOn", newState) end)
		applyToggleEnableState(newState)
	end

	-- Clicks go through toggleEnableAll too: a mixed selection shows IsOn false, and the widget's own
	-- flip would turn everything on instead of off.
	if UI.ToggleEnableButton then
		Connections["ToggleEnable"] = UI.ToggleEnableButton.Activated:Connect(function()
			UI.toggleEnableAll()
		end)
	end
end

				menuRow.Visible = applies

		end
	end

--[[
	Usage: sends the plugin's elapsed time to the server every USAGE_PING_INTERVAL and at shutdown.
	Each load has its own session id; the server counts time only from the session holding the
	user's lock, so a second Studio window's pings count nothing. The lock lapses after
	worker.js LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS of silence, which must stay above one ping interval.
	The server counts a session's first ping up to one interval (worker.js PING_INTERVAL_MS, kept
	equal to USAGE_PING_INTERVAL): a longer interval here loses time on each first ping.
]]

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

return function(deps)
	local Auth = deps.Auth
	local getActive = deps.getActive

	local USAGE_PING_INTERVAL = 1800 -- seconds
	-- New on each plugin load (Studio open or a toggle on), sent with every ping.
	local _sessionId = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	local _thread, _lastClock = nil, nil

	local function pingUsage(deltaMs)
		if not deltaMs or deltaMs < 1 then return end
		local userId = Auth.getUserId()
		if not userId or userId <= 0 then return end
		-- Failures and rejections are ignored: a rejected session keeps pinging and takes the lock once
		-- it lapses. Auth.httpRequest retries the fallback host.
		Auth.httpRequest({
			Path = "/usage",
			Method = "POST",
			Headers = {
				["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
				["X-Plugin-Token"] = Auth.getPluginToken(),
			},
			Body = HttpService:JSONEncode({
				userId = tostring(userId),
				sessionId = _sessionId,
				deltaMs = deltaMs,
			}),
		})
	end

	local function flush()
		if not _lastClock then return end
		local now = os.clock()
		local deltaMs = (now - _lastClock) * 1000
		_lastClock = now
		pingUsage(deltaMs)
	end

	local function start()
		if _thread then return end
		_lastClock = os.clock()
		_thread = task.spawn(function()
			while getActive() do
				task.wait(USAGE_PING_INTERVAL)
				if not getActive() then break end
				flush()
			end
		end)
	end

	-- Never yields: teardown calls it, and Studio stops a teardown run from plugin.Unloading at its
	-- first yield. The last ping, whose request yields, goes from its own thread after the state is
	-- cleared.
	local function stop()
		local elapsedMs = _lastClock and (os.clock() - _lastClock) * 1000
		if _thread then pcall(task.cancel, _thread); _thread = nil end
		_lastClock = nil
		if elapsedMs then
			task.spawn(pingUsage, elapsedMs)
		end
	end

	return { start = start, stop = stop }
end

-- Numbers parsed from CSV text, padded to `count` with the last value ("5" -> {5, 5}), or nil
-- when nothing parses or when `count` tokens were typed and some do not ("66, 66ab").
function Utility.parseCSV(text, count)
	local expected = count or 1
	local tokens = 0
	local values = {}
	for v in text:gmatch("[^,]+") do
		tokens = tokens + 1
		local n = tonumber(v:match("^%s*(.+)%s*$"))
		if n then table.insert(values, n) end
	end
	if #values == 0 then return nil end
	if tokens >= expected and #values < expected then return nil end
	while #values < expected do table.insert(values, values[#values] or 0) end
	return values
end

-- A brief red flash on a TextBox for invalid input (Connectors re-exports it).
function Utility.flashInvalid(input)
	if not input then return end
	local orig = input.TextColor3
	input.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
	task.delay(0.35, function() if input and input.Parent then input.TextColor3 = orig end end)
end

-- Right of the primary panel, or left where the right would leave the screen. Every Inventory
-- detail module uses it.
function Utility.positionPanelBeside(primary, detail, gap)
	if not primary or not detail then return end
	-- Details docked inside their panel (the Inventory outside Classic) stay put.
	if detail:IsDescendantOf(primary) then return end
	gap = gap or 4
	local sg = primary:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
	local scale = 1
	if sg then local us = sg:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale"); if us then scale = us.Scale end end
	local invPos = primary.AbsolutePosition / scale
	local invSize = primary.AbsoluteSize / scale
	local detW = detail.AbsoluteSize.X / scale
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local screenW = (cam and cam.ViewportSize.X / scale) or 1920
	local rightX = invPos.X + invSize.X + gap
	if rightX + detW <= screenW then
		detail.Position = UDim2.new(0, rightX, 0, invPos.Y)
	else
		detail.Position = UDim2.new(0, invPos.X - detW - gap, 0, invPos.Y)
	end
end

-- -> value, isVariable. NumberRange == compares references, so its Min and Max are compared;
-- the other value types compare by content.
function Utility.getCommonFromItems(items, getter)
	if #items == 0 then return nil, false end
	local first = getter(items[1])
	local firstType = typeof(first)
	if firstType == "NumberRange" then
		local fmin, fmax = first.Min, first.Max
		for i = 2, #items do
			local v = getter(items[i])
			if typeof(v) ~= "NumberRange" or v.Min ~= fmin or v.Max ~= fmax then return nil, true end
		end
	else
		for i = 2, #items do
			if getter(items[i]) ~= first then return nil, true end
		end
	end
	return first, false
end

-- One value, no envelope, at every keypoint.
function Utility.isNSFlat(seq)
	if not seq or typeof(seq) ~= "NumberSequence" then return false end
	local kps = seq.Keypoints
	local v = kps[1].Value
	for _, kp in ipairs(kps) do
		if math.abs(kp.Value - v) > 0.0001 or kp.Envelope > 0.001 then return false end
	end
	return true
end

function Utility.isCSFlat(cs)
	if not cs or typeof(cs) ~= "ColorSequence" then return false end
	local kps = cs.Keypoints
	local c = kps[1].Value
	for _, kp in ipairs(kps) do
		if math.abs(kp.Value.R - c.R) > 0.002 or math.abs(kp.Value.G - c.G) > 0.002 or math.abs(kp.Value.B - c.B) > 0.002 then return false end
	end
	return true
end

-- "R, G, B" in 0 to 255.
function Utility.color3ToRGB(c)
	return string.format("%d, %d, %d", math.floor(c.R*255+0.5), math.floor(c.G*255+0.5), math.floor(c.B*255+0.5))
end

function Utility.parseRGB(txt)
	local parts = {}
	for num in txt:gmatch("[%d%.]+") do table.insert(parts, tonumber(num)) end
	if #parts < 3 then return nil end
	return Color3.fromRGB(math.clamp(parts[1],0,255), math.clamp(parts[2],0,255), math.clamp(parts[3],0,255))
end

-- The same value and envelope at every keypoint.
function Utility.isNSRange(seq)
	if not seq or typeof(seq) ~= "NumberSequence" then return false end
	local kps = seq.Keypoints
	local v, e = kps[1].Value, kps[1].Envelope
	if e < 0.001 then return false end
	for _, kp in ipairs(kps) do
		if math.abs(kp.Value - v) > 0.0001 or math.abs(kp.Envelope - e) > 0.0001 then return false end
	end
	return true
end

function Utility.populateGraphInput(ref, seq)
	if not ref or not ref.input then return end
	if seq and typeof(seq) == "NumberSequence" then
		if Utility.isNSFlat(seq) then
			ref.input.Text = string.format("%.4g", seq.Keypoints[1].Value)
		elseif Utility.isNSRange(seq) then
			local v, e = seq.Keypoints[1].Value, seq.Keypoints[1].Envelope
			ref.input.Text = string.format("%.4g, %.4g", v - e, v + e)
		else
			ref.input.Text = "<NumberSequence>"
		end
	else
		ref.input.Text = "0"
	end
end

function Utility.populateColorInput(ref, cs)
	if not ref or not ref.input then return end
	if cs and typeof(cs) == "ColorSequence" then
		local firstColor = cs.Keypoints[1].Value
		if ref.swatch then
			local grad = ref.swatch:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
			if Utility.isCSFlat(cs) then
				ref.swatch.BackgroundColor3 = firstColor
				if grad then grad:Destroy() end
			else
				ref.swatch.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
				if not grad then grad = Instance.new("UIGradient"); grad.Parent = ref.swatch end
				grad.Color = cs
			end
		end
		if Utility.isCSFlat(cs) then
			ref.input.Text = Utility.color3ToRGB(firstColor)
		else
			ref.input.Text = "<ColorSequence>"
		end
	else
		if ref.swatch then
			ref.swatch.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1)
			local grad = ref.swatch:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIGradient")
			if grad then grad:Destroy() end
		end
		ref.input.Text = "255, 255, 255"
	end
end

-- Renames an item's state Configurations "1".."N" in the order the Blender box and the Clipboard
-- list them (ClipSlots: by Time, a state without one by its name, as the runtime reads it).

-- True when two module trees hold the same scripts with the same sources (root names ignored).
local function sameModuleTree(a, b)
	if a.ClassName ~= b.ClassName then return false end
	if a:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") and a.Source ~= b.Source then return false end
	local aChildren = a:GetChildren()
	local bChildren = b:GetChildren()
	if #aChildren ~= #bChildren then return false end
	local byName = {}
	for _, child in ipairs(bChildren) do byName[child.Name] = child end
	for _, child in ipairs(aChildren) do
		local other = byName[child.Name]
		if not other or not sameModuleTree(child, other) then return false end
	end
	return true
end

-- A fresh copy of `source` (Modules/Part) named Part_Icles under `root`, replacing the one there;
-- with `always` false a root without a copy is left alone. An identical copy is kept: adding ~100
-- scripts makes Studio analyse them all, a multi-second freeze. Writes the open place.
function Utility.replaceRuntimeModule(source, root, always)
	local existing = root:FindFirstChild("Part_Icles")
	if not existing and not always then return end
	if existing and sameModuleTree(existing, source) then return end
	if existing then pcall(existing.Destroy, existing) end
	local fresh = source:Clone()
	fresh.Name = "Part_Icles"
	fresh.Parent = root
end

return Utility
